ko.title: [Marketing 101 #13] 당신이 얻을 수 있는 가장 저렴한 고객은 이미 보유한 고객입니다

segments.src: > Modern marketing runs on two questions: what is a customer worth over their whole relationship with you, and how much did it cost to get them? Everything else — the CRM, the dashboards, the ad spend — exists to answer those two.
segments.tr: > 현대 마케팅은 두 가지 질문을 중심으로 돌아갑니다. 고객이 나와의 전체 관계 기간 동안 창출하는 가치는 얼마인가, 그리고 그들을 확보하는 데 얼마의 비용이 들었는가 하는 점입니다. CRM, 대시보드, 광고비를 포함한 나머지 모든 요소는 이 두 가지 질문에 답하기 위해 존재합니다.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## 오늘의 개념

segments.src: For most of the 20th century, marketing was measured in *transactions*.
segments.tr: 20세기 대부분의 기간 동안 마케팅은 *거래*를 기준으로 측정되었습니다.

segments.src: You ran a campaign, sales went up or they didn't, and you moved on.
segments.tr: 캠페인을 집행하면 매출이 오르거나 오르지 않았고, 그렇게 마케팅은 끝났습니다.

segments.src: Data-driven marketing swaps the unit of measurement from the transaction to the **relationship**.
segments.tr: 데이터 중심 마케팅은 측정 단위를 거래에서 **관계**로 전환합니다.

segments.src: The core number is **customer lifetime value (CLV, sometimes LTV)** — the total profit you expect from one customer across the entire time they stay with you.
segments.tr: 핵심 지표는 **고객 생애 가치(CLV, 때로는 LTV)**로, 고객이 머무는 전체 기간 동안 한 명의 고객으로부터 기대할 수 있는 총이익을 의미합니다.

segments.src: For a repeat-purchase business, the plain-English version looks like this:
segments.tr: 재구매가 발생하는 비즈니스의 경우, 이를 알기 쉽게 표현하면 다음과 같습니다:

segments.src: CLV = average order value  x  orders per year  x  gross margin  x  years retained
segments.tr: CLV = average order value  x  orders per year  x  gross margin  x  years retained

segments.src: Set that next to what it cost to win the customer — **customer acquisition cost (CAC)**, which is total sales and marketing spend divided by new customers acquired — and you get the ratio that quietly governs a lot of business decisions:
segments.tr: 이를 고객을 확보하는 데 든 비용, 즉 총 영업 및 마케팅 지출을 신규 획득 고객 수로 나눈 **고객 획득 비용(CAC)**과 비교하면 많은 비즈니스 결정을 조용히 지배하는 비율이 완성됩니다:

segments.src: LTV : CAC
segments.tr: LTV : CAC

segments.src: The common rule of thumb in subscription and DTC businesses is that a healthy ratio is around 3:1.
segments.tr: 구독 및 DTC 비즈니스에서 통용되는 일반적인 경험 법칙에 따르면 건강한 비율은 약 3:1입니다.

segments.src: That number is a heuristic, not a law of nature — a business with fat margins and cheap servicing can survive on less; one with heavy fulfillment costs needs more.
segments.tr: 그 수치는 자연의 법칙이 아니라 경험적 규칙입니다. 마진이 높고 서비스 비용이 저렴한 비즈니스는 그보다 낮은 비율로도 생존할 수 있지만, 이행 비용이 많이 드는 비즈니스는 더 높은 비율이 필요합니다.

segments.src: The useful part isn't the magic number.
segments.tr: 유용한 부분은 마법 같은 숫자에 있지 않습니다.

segments.src: It's the realization that **you can improve the ratio from either side**: spend less to acquire, or keep people longer.
segments.tr: 핵심은 **양쪽 모두에서 비율을 개선할 수 있다**는 깨달음입니다. 즉, 획득 비용을 줄이거나 고객을 더 오래 유지하는 것입니다.

segments.src: Two disciplines sit on either side of that ratio.
segments.tr: 이 비율의 양쪽에는 각각 두 가지 영역이 자리 잡고 있습니다.

segments.src: **Performance marketing** works the CAC side.
segments.tr: **퍼포먼스 마케팅**은 CAC 측면을 담당합니다.

segments.src: It's advertising bought and judged on measurable outcomes — clicks, signups, purchases — rather than on impressions or brand sentiment.
segments.tr: 이는 노출이나 브랜드 감성보다는 클릭, 가입, 구매 등 측정 가능한 결과를 바탕으로 집행되고 평가되는 광고입니다.

segments.src: Its native metrics are CAC and **ROAS** (revenue divided by ad spend).
segments.tr: 그 고유한 지표는 CAC와 **ROAS**(광고비 대비 매출액)입니다.

segments.src: Its superpower is fast feedback; you can kill a bad ad in a day.
segments.tr: 그 강력한 무기는 빠른 피드백입니다. 성과가 나쁜 광고는 하루 만에 중단할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: **CRM** — customer relationship management — works the retention side.
segments.tr: **CRM**(고객 관계 관리)은 유지(retention) 측면을 담당합니다.

segments.src: The phrase means two things at once: the *practice* of managing customer relationships deliberately, and the *software* (Salesforce, HubSpot, Klaviyo, and dozens more) that stores every customer's purchases, emails, support tickets, and behavior in one record.
segments.tr: 이 용어는 두 가지 의미를 동시에 내포합니다. 고객과의 관계를 의도적으로 관리하는 *실행 방식*과, 모든 고객의 구매, 이메일, 지원 티켓, 행동 양식을 하나의 레코드에 저장하는 *소프트웨어*(Salesforce, HubSpot, Klaviyo 등 수많은 도구)입니다.

segments.src: The software matters because it turns "we should really follow up with lapsed buyers" into a query you can actually run and a message you can actually send.
segments.tr: 이 소프트웨어가 중요한 이유는 "구매가 끊긴 구매자들에게 정말 연락을 취해야 한다"라는 생각을 실제로 실행할 수 있는 쿼리로 바꾸고 실제로 보낼 수 있는 메시지로 만들어주기 때문입니다.

segments.src: One honest caveat before the example: these systems measure *correlation with* a sale, not *cause of* a sale.
segments.tr: 예시로 넘어가기 전에 한 가지 솔직한 주의 사항을 짚고 넘어가겠습니다. 이 시스템들은 판매의 *원인*이 아니라 판매와의 *상관관계*를 측정합니다.

segments.src: A returning customer who was going to buy anyway may click your retargeting ad on the way — and the ad gets the credit.
segments.tr: 어차피 구매하려고 했던 재방문 고객이 가는 길에 리타게팅 광고를 클릭할 수 있으며, 이 경우 광고가 성과의 공로를 인정받게 됩니다.

segments.src: Privacy changes across browsers and mobile platforms over the past several years have also made click-level tracking less complete than the dashboards imply.
segments.tr: 지난 몇 년간 브라우저와 모바일 플랫폼 전반에서 이루어진 프라이버시 정책 변화 역시 클릭 수준의 추적을 대시보드가 암시하는 것보다 불완전하게 만들었습니다.

segments.src: Serious teams check their attribution numbers against **incrementality tests** — holding ads back from a randomized region or audience and comparing sales to a region that still sees them.
segments.tr: 진지한 팀들은 어트리뷰션(기여도) 수치를 **증분 테스트(incrementality tests)**와 비교하여 검증합니다. 즉, 무작위로 선정된 지역이나 오디세이 대상에게는 광고를 노출하지 않고, 여전히 광고가 노출되는 지역과 매출을 비교하는 것입니다.

segments.src: It's the closest thing marketing has to a control group.
segments.tr: 이는 마케팅에서 통제 집단(대조군)에 가장 가까운 방법입니다.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## 일상생활 속에서

segments.src: Take Cedar & Co., a small coffee roaster in Denver selling 12 oz bags online at $18, with a 40% gross margin.
segments.tr: 덴버에 위치한 소규모 커피 로스터리인 '시더 앤 코(Cedar & Co.)'의 예를 들어보겠습니다. 이들은 온라인에서 12온스 백을 18달러에 판매하며 40%의 매출총이익률을 기록하고 있습니다.

segments.src: They run Meta and Google ads and pay about **$45 to acquire each new customer**.
segments.tr: 이들은 메타와 구글 광고를 집행하며 **신규 고객 한 명을 획득하는 데 약 45달러**를 지불합니다.

segments.src: Their typical subscriber orders once a month and sticks around 18 months.
segments.tr: 일반적인 구독자는 한 달에 한 번 주문하고 약 18개월 동안 머뭅니다.

segments.src: CLV = $18 x 12 orders/yr x 0.40 margin x 1.5 years = $129.60
segments.tr: CLV = $18 x 12 orders/yr x 0.40 margin x 1.5 years = $129.60

segments.src: Workable, not comfortable.
segments.tr: 돌아갈 수는 있지만 편안한 상황은 아닙니다.

segments.src: The founder's instinct is to fix it by finding cheaper ads.
segments.tr: 창업자의 본능은 더 저렴한 광고를 찾아 이 문제를 해결하려고 합니다.

segments.src: But look what happens if their CRM data does the work instead.
segments.tr: 하지만 CRM 데이터가 그 역할을 대신 수행하면 어떤 일이 벌어지는지 살펴보세요.

segments.src: Digging into the customer records, they notice a pattern: most cancellations cluster right after month five, and those customers had never tried anything but the house blend.
segments.tr: 고객 기록을 파고들어 보면 패턴이 나타납니다. 대부분의 구독 취소는 5개월 차 직후에 집중되며, 해당 고객들은 하우스 블렌드 외에는 다른 제품을 시도해 본 적이 없었습니다.

segments.src: So they set up an automated CRM flow — at month four, anyone who's only ever ordered one product gets an email with a free single-origin sample in their next box.
segments.tr: 그래서 이들은 자동화된 CRM 플로우를 설정합니다. 4개월 차에 오직 하나의 제품만 주문해 온 고객에게 다음 박스에 무료 싱글 오리진 샘플이 담긴 이메일을 발송하는 것입니다.

segments.src: Say that pushes average retention from 18 months to 24:
segments.tr: 이를 통해 평균 유지 기간이 18개월에서 24개월로 늘어난다고 가정해 보겠습니다:

segments.src: Same ad budget.
segments.tr: 광고 예산은 동일합니다.

segments.src: Same CAC.
segments.tr: CAC도 동일합니다.

segments.src: A 33% jump in customer value, bought with an email and a sample bag.
segments.tr: 이메일 한 통과 샘플 백 하나로 고객 가치가 33% 급증했습니다.

segments.src: That's the whole argument for CRM in one example.
segments.tr: 이것이 단 하나의 예시로 설명하는 CRM의 모든 주장입니다.

segments.src: Performance marketing can usually shave CAC by maybe 10–20% before you hit the floor of what a click costs in a competitive auction.
segments.tr: 퍼포먼스 마케팅은 경쟁 입찰에서 클릭 비용의 바닥에 도달하기 전에 대개 CAC를 10~20% 정도 낮출 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Retention has far more headroom — and unlike your ad account, no competitor can bid it away from you.
segments.tr: 유지(Retention)에는 훨씬 더 많은 여유 공간이 있으며, 광고 계정과 달리 경쟁업체가 이를 입찰로 빼앗아 갈 수 없습니다.

segments.src: The flip side is real too: if Cedar & Co.
segments.tr: 반대의 경우도 마찬가지입니다. 시더 앤 코의

segments.src: had lousy coffee, no CRM flow would save them.
segments.tr: 커피가 형편없었다면 어떤 CRM 플로우도 그들을 구할 수 없을 것입니다.

segments.src: Retention work amplifies a product people want.
segments.tr: 유지 작업은 사람들이 원하는 제품에 힘을 실어줍니다.

segments.src: It does not manufacture one.
segments.tr: 제품 자체를 만들어내지는 못합니다.

segments.src: ## Three-Line Summary
segments.tr: ## 세 줄 요약

segments.src: 1. **CLV** is the profit a customer generates over the whole relationship; compared against **CAC**, it tells you whether growth is actually creating value or just buying revenue.
segments.tr: 1. **CLV**는 고객과의 전체 관계 기간 동안 고객이 창출하는 이익입니다. **CAC**와 비교했을 때, 성장이 실제로 가치를 창출하고 있는지 아니면 단순히 매출을 사고 있는지 알려줍니다.

segments.src: 2. **Performance marketing** lowers the cost of acquiring customers; **CRM** raises what each one is worth — and retention usually has more room to move.
segments.tr: 2. **퍼포먼스 마케팅**은 고객 획득 비용을 낮추고, **CRM**은 각 고객의 가치를 높여줍니다. 그리고 유지(retention) 분야는 대개 개선할 수 있는 여지가 더 많습니다.

segments.src: 3. Dashboards show correlation, not causation, so test your ad claims against a holdout before you trust them.
segments.tr: 3. 대시보드는 인과관계가 아닌 상관관계를 보여주므로, 광고 주장을 신뢰하기 전에 보류 집단(holdout)과 비교하여 테스트해야 합니다.

segments.src: ## ✅ Self Quiz
segments.tr: ## ✅ 자체 퀴즈

segments.src: **1.** A company reports an LTV:CAC ratio of 1.2:1.
segments.tr: **1.** 한 회사가 LTV:CAC 비율을 1.2:1이라고 보고했습니다.

segments.src: What does that most likely mean?
segments.tr: 이는 가장 가능성이 높은 의미가 무엇인가요?

segments.src: - (a) The business is healthy and should spend more on ads
segments.tr: - (a) 비즈니스가 건실하며 광고에 더 많은 지출을 해야 한다

segments.src: - (b) It costs nearly as much to acquire a customer as that customer will ever return in profit
segments.tr: - (b) 고객을 획득하는 데 드는 비용이 해당 고객이 이익으로 돌려주는 금액만큼 거의 소요된다

segments.src: - (c) The CRM system is misconfigured
segments.tr: - (c) CRM 시스템이 잘못 구성되었다

segments.src: - (d) Gross margin is too high
segments.tr: - (d) 매출총이익률이 너무 높다

segments.src: **2.** (O/X) Improving customer retention can raise CLV without increasing ad spend at all.
segments.tr: **2.** (O/X) 고객 유지를 개선하면 광고비를 전혀 늘리지 않고도 CLV를 높일 수 있습니다.

segments.src: **3.** Which of these is a CRM system best suited for?
segments.tr: **3.** 다음 중 CRM 시스템이 가장 적합한 용도는 무엇인가요?

segments.src: - (a) Proving that a specific ad campaign *caused* a sale
segments.tr: - (a) 특정 광고 캠페인이 판매를 *유발*했음을 증명하기

segments.src: - (b) Setting the optimal price for a product
segments.tr: - (b) 제품의 최적 가격 설정하기

segments.src: - (c) Keeping one shared record of each customer's history so teams can act on it
segments.tr: - (c) 팀이 이를 바탕으로 행동할 수 있도록 각 고객의 이력을 공유된 하나의 레코드로 유지하기

segments.src: - (d) Replacing the need for a marketing strategy
segments.tr: - (d) 마케팅 전략의 필요성 대체하기

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 오늘의 용어

segments.src: - **Customer Lifetime Value (CLV / LTV)** — the total profit a business expects from a single customer over the full length of the relationship.
segments.tr: - **고객 생애 가치(CLV / LTV)** — 관계가 유지되는 전체 기간 동안 단일 고객으로부터 비즈니스가 기대하는 총이익.

segments.src: - **Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC)** — total sales and marketing spend divided by the number of new customers it produced.
segments.tr: - **고객 획득 비용(CAC)** — 총 영업 및 마케팅 지출을 창출된 신규 고객 수로 나눈 값.

segments.src: - **Churn Rate** — the share of customers who stop buying or cancel in a given period; the direct enemy of CLV.
segments.tr: - **이탈률(Churn Rate)** — 주어진 기간 동안 구매를 중단하거나 구독을 취소한 고객의 비율. CLV의 직접적인 적.

segments.src: - **ROAS (Return on Ad Spend)** — revenue generated per dollar of advertising, the standard scorecard of performance marketing.
segments.tr: - **ROAS(광고비 대비 매출액)** — 광고비 1달러당 창출된 매출로, 퍼포먼스 마케팅의 표준 성과 지표.

segments.src: - **CRM** — both the practice of managing customer relationships over time and the software that centralizes each customer's history so those relationships can be acted on at scale.
segments.tr: - **CRM** — 시간에 따라 고객 관계를 관리하는 실무 방식과, 해당 관계를 대규모로 활용할 수 있도록 각 고객의 이력을 중앙화하는 소프트웨어 모두를 의미합니다.

segments.src: *Answers: 1 — (b).
At 1.2:1 there's almost no margin left to cover overhead, product development, or mistakes; growth like this consumes cash rather than generating it.
segments.tr: 1.2:1 비율에서는 간접비, 제품 개발비, 혹은 실수를 충당할 마진이 거의 남지 않습니다. 이와 같은 성장은 이익을 창출하기보다는 현상을 소모합니다.

segments.src: Retention is the "years retained" term in the CLV formula, and stretching it costs nothing in media spend.
segments.tr: 유지는 CLV 공식에서 "유지된 연수"에 해당하는 항목이며, 이를 늘리는 데는 미디어 지출 비용이 들지 않습니다.

segments.src: A CRM is a system of record that makes targeted action possible; proving causation requires an incrementality test with a holdout group, not a CRM.*
segments.tr: CRM은 타겟팅된 행동을 가능하게 하는 기록 시스템입니다. 인과관계를 증명하려면 CRM이 아니라 보류 집단(holdout group)을 포함한 증분 테스트가 필요합니다.*

zh.title: [Marketing 101 #13] 你能买到的最便宜的客户就是你已经拥有的客户

segments.src: > Modern marketing runs on two questions: what is a customer worth over their whole relationship with you, and how much did it cost to get them? Everything else — the CRM, the dashboards, the ad spend — exists to answer those two.
segments.tr: > 现代营销围绕两个问题展开：客户在与你的整个合作关系中价值几何，以及获取他们花费了多少？其他一切——CRM、仪表板、广告支出——的存在都是为了回答这两个问题。

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## 今日概念

segments.src: For most of the 20th century, marketing was measured in *transactions*.
segments.tr: 在20世纪的大部分时间里，营销是以*交易*来衡量的。

segments.src: You ran a campaign, sales went up or they didn't, and you moved on.
segments.tr: 你开展了一场活动，销售额上升了或者没有上升，然后你就继续前进了。

segments.src: Data-driven marketing swaps the unit of measurement from the transaction to the **relationship**.
segments.tr: 数据驱动的营销将计量单位从交易转变为**关系**。

segments.src: The core number is **customer lifetime value (CLV, sometimes LTV)** — the total profit you expect from one customer across the entire time they stay with you.
segments.tr: 核心数字是**客户生命周期价值（CLV，有时也称LTV）**——即你预期一个客户在与你保持关系的整个期间内带来的总利润。

segments.src: For a repeat-purchase business, the plain-English version looks like this:
segments.tr: 对于重复购买业务，用白话文解释如下：

segments.src: CLV = average order value  x  orders per year  x  gross margin  x  years retained
segments.tr: CLV = average order value  x  orders per year  x  gross margin  x  years retained

segments.src: Set that next to what it cost to win the customer — **customer acquisition cost (CAC)**, which is total sales and marketing spend divided by new customers acquired — and you get the ratio that quietly governs a lot of business decisions:
segments.tr: 将这个数字与获取客户的成本——**获客成本（CAC）**（即总销售和营销支出除以获得的新客户数）进行对比，你就会得到一个默默左右许多商业决策的比率：

segments.src: LTV : CAC
segments.tr: LTV : CAC

segments.src: The common rule of thumb in subscription and DTC businesses is that a healthy ratio is around 3:1.
segments.tr: 订阅制和DTC（直接面向消费者）业务中常见的经验法则是，健康的比例大约是 3:1。

segments.src: That number is a heuristic, not a law of nature — a business with fat margins and cheap servicing can survive on less; one with heavy fulfillment costs needs more.
segments.tr: 这个数字是一个经验法则，而不是自然规律——利润率高、服务成本低的企业可以用更低的比例生存；而履约成本高昂的企业则需要更高的比例。

segments.src: The useful part isn't the magic number.
segments.tr: 有用的部分不是这个神奇的数字。

segments.src: It's the realization that **you can improve the ratio from either side**: spend less to acquire, or keep people longer.
segments.tr: 而是意识到**你可以从任何一方改善这个比率**：减少获取成本，或者留住用户更长时间。

segments.src: Two disciplines sit on either side of that ratio.
segments.tr: 有两个学科分别位于该比率的两侧。

segments.src: **Performance marketing** works the CAC side.
segments.tr: **效果营销**致力于降低CAC。

segments.src: It's advertising bought and judged on measurable outcomes — clicks, signups, purchases — rather than on impressions or brand sentiment.
segments.tr: 它是根据可衡量的结果（点击量、注册量、购买量）来购买和评判的广告，而不是根据展示次数或品牌情感。

segments.src: Its native metrics are CAC and **ROAS** (revenue divided by ad spend).
segments.tr: 其原生指标是CAC和**ROAS**（收入除以广告支出）。

segments.src: Its superpower is fast feedback; you can kill a bad ad in a day.
segments.tr: 它的超能力是快速反馈；你可以在一天内停掉一个效果不佳的广告。

segments.src: **CRM** — customer relationship management — works the retention side.
segments.tr: **CRM**——客户关系管理——致力于留存这一端。

segments.src: The phrase means two things at once: the *practice* of managing customer relationships deliberately, and the *software* (Salesforce, HubSpot, Klaviyo, and dozens more) that stores every customer's purchases, emails, support tickets, and behavior in one record.
segments.tr: 这个短语同时意味着两件事：有意管理客户关系的*实践*，以及将每个客户的购买、电子邮件、支持工单和行为存储在一个记录中的*软件*（Salesforce、HubSpot、Klaviyo等数十种）。

segments.src: The software matters because it turns "we should really follow up with lapsed buyers" into a query you can actually run and a message you can actually send.
segments.tr: 该软件之所以重要，是因为它将“我们真的应该跟进流失的买家”变成了一个你可以实际运行的查询和一个你可以实际发送的消息。

segments.src: One honest caveat before the example: these systems measure *correlation with* a sale, not *cause of* a sale.
segments.tr: 在举例之前有一个诚实的警告：这些系统衡量的是与销售的*相关性*，而不是销售的*原因*。

segments.src: A returning customer who was going to buy anyway may click your retargeting ad on the way — and the ad gets the credit.
segments.tr: 一个无论如何都会购买的回头客可能会在路上点击你的重定向广告——而广告获得了功劳。

segments.src: Privacy changes across browsers and mobile platforms over the past several years have also made click-level tracking less complete than the dashboards imply.
segments.tr: 过去几年中，各个浏览器和移动平台的隐私变化也使得点击级别的追踪不如仪表板所暗示的那样完整。

segments.src: Serious teams check their attribution numbers against **incrementality tests** — holding ads back from a randomized region or audience and comparing sales to a region that still sees them.
segments.tr: 严肃的团队会通过**增量测试**来对照其归因数字——从随机区域或受众中扣除广告，并将销售额与仍然看到广告的区域进行比较。

segments.src: It's the closest thing marketing has to a control group.
segments.tr: 这是营销中最接近对照组的方法。

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## 在日常生活中

segments.src: Take Cedar & Co., a small coffee roaster in Denver selling 12 oz bags online at $18, with a 40% gross margin.
segments.tr: 以 Cedar & Co. 为例，这是一家位于丹佛的小型咖啡烘焙商，在线以 18 美元的价格出售 12 盎司装的咖啡，毛利率为 40%。

segments.src: They run Meta and Google ads and pay about **$45 to acquire each new customer**.
segments.tr: 他们投放 Meta 和 Google 广告，**获取每个新客户大约花费 45 美元**。

segments.src: Their typical subscriber orders once a month and sticks around 18 months.
segments.tr: 他们的典型订阅者每月订购一次，并留存大约 18 个月。

segments.src: CLV = $18 x 12 orders/yr x 0.40 margin x 1.5 years = $129.60
segments.tr: CLV = $18 x 12 orders/yr x 0.40 margin x 1.5 years = $129.60

segments.src: Workable, not comfortable.
segments.tr: 行得通，但不舒服。

segments.src: The founder's instinct is to fix it by finding cheaper ads.
segments.tr: 创始人的直觉是通过寻找更便宜的广告来解决问题。

segments.src: But look what happens if their CRM data does the work instead.
segments.tr: 但如果让 CRM 数据来发挥作用，看看会发生什么。

segments.src: Digging into the customer records, they notice a pattern: most cancellations cluster right after month five, and those customers had never tried anything but the house blend.
segments.tr: 深入研究客户记录，他们注意到一个规律：大多数取消订阅都集中在第五个月之后，而这些客户除了招牌混合咖啡外从未尝试过其他任何东西。

segments.src: So they set up an automated CRM flow — at month four, anyone who's only ever ordered one product gets an email with a free single-origin sample in their next box.
segments.tr: 因此，他们设置了一个自动 CRM 流程——在第四个月，任何只订购过一种产品的人都会收到一封电子邮件，并在他们的下一个盒子中获得免费的单一产地样品。

segments.src: Say that pushes average retention from 18 months to 24:
segments.tr: 假设这把平均留存时间从 18 个月推高到 24 个月：

segments.src: Same ad budget.
segments.tr: 相同的广告预算。

segments.src: Same CAC.
segments.tr: 相同的CAC。

segments.src: A 33% jump in customer value, bought with an email and a sample bag.
segments.tr: 客户价值跃升了 33%，用一封电子邮件和一个样品袋买下。

segments.src: That's the whole argument for CRM in one example.
segments.tr: 这就是整个 CRM 论点的一个例子。

segments.src: Performance marketing can usually shave CAC by maybe 10–20% before you hit the floor of what a click costs in a competitive auction.
segments.tr: 在竞争激烈的竞价中触及点击成本的底线之前，效果营销通常可以将 CAC 削减大约 10–20%。

segments.src: Retention has far more headroom — and unlike your ad account, no competitor can bid it away from you.
segments.tr: 留存率有更大的提升空间——而且与你的广告账户不同，没有任何竞争对手可以将其从你手中竞标夺走。

segments.src: The flip side is real too: if Cedar & Co.
segments.tr: 另一面同样真实：如果 Cedar & Co.

segments.src: had lousy coffee, no CRM flow would save them.
segments.tr: 的咖啡很糟糕，没有任何 CRM 流程能救得了他们。

segments.src: Retention work amplifies a product people want.
segments.tr: 留存工作放大了人们想要的产品。

segments.src: It does not manufacture one.
segments.tr: 它并不能制造产品。

segments.src: ## Three-Line Summary
segments.tr: ## 三行总结

segments.src: 1. **CLV** is the profit a customer generates over the whole relationship; compared against **CAC**, it tells you whether growth is actually creating value or just buying revenue.
segments.tr: 1. **CLV** 是客户在整个关系中产生的利润；与 **CAC** 相比，它告诉你增长究竟是在创造价值还是仅仅在买入收入。

segments.src: 2. **Performance marketing** lowers the cost of acquiring customers; **CRM** raises what each one is worth — and retention usually has more room to move.
segments.tr: 2. **效果营销**降低了获取客户的成本；**CRM** 提高了每个客户的价值——而且留存率通常有更大的提升空间。

segments.src: 3. Dashboards show correlation, not causation, so test your ad claims against a holdout before you trust them.
segments.tr: 3. 仪表板显示的是相关性，而不是因果关系，所以在相信你的广告主张之前，请对照留存组进行测试。

segments.src: ## ✅ Self Quiz
segments.tr: ## ✅ 自我测验

segments.src: **1.** A company reports an LTV:CAC ratio of 1.2:1.
segments.tr: **1.** 一家公司报告的 LTV:CAC 比率为 1.2:1。

segments.src: What does that most likely mean?
segments.tr: 这最可能意味着什么？

segments.src: - (a) The business is healthy and should spend more on ads
segments.tr: - (a) 业务健康，应该在广告上投入更多

segments.src: - (b) It costs nearly as much to acquire a customer as that customer will ever return in profit
segments.tr: - (b) 获取一个客户的成本几乎与该客户一生中能带来的利润回报一样多

segments.src: - (c) The CRM system is misconfigured
segments.tr: - (c) CRM 系统配置错误

segments.src: - (d) Gross margin is too high
segments.tr: - (d) 毛利率太高

segments.src: **2.** (O/X) Improving customer retention can raise CLV without increasing ad spend at all.
segments.tr: **2.** (O/X) 提高客户留存率可以在根本不增加广告支出 的情况下提高 CLV。

segments.src: **3.** Which of these is a CRM system best suited for?
segments.tr: **3.** 以下哪项最适合 CRM 系统？

segments.src: - (a) Proving that a specific ad campaign *caused* a sale
segments.tr: - (a) 证明特定的广告活动*导致*了销售

segments.src: - (b) Setting the optimal price for a product
segments.tr: - (b) 为产品设定最优价格

segments.src: - (c) Keeping one shared record of each customer's history so teams can act on it
segments.tr: - (c) 保留每个客户历史的单一共享记录，以便团队据此采取行动

segments.src: - (d) Replacing the need for a marketing strategy
segments.tr: - (d) 取代对营销策略的需求

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 今日术语

segments.src: - **Customer Lifetime Value (CLV / LTV)** — the total profit a business expects from a single customer over the full length of the relationship.
segments.tr: - **Customer Lifetime Value (CLV / LTV)** — 企业期望从单个客户在整个关系长度中获得的的总利润。

segments.src: - **Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC)** — total sales and marketing spend divided by the number of new customers it produced.
segments.tr: - **Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC)** — 总销售和营销支出除以产生的新客户数量。

segments.src: - **Churn Rate** — the share of customers who stop buying or cancel in a given period; the direct enemy of CLV.
segments.tr: - **Churn Rate** — 在给定时期内停止购买或取消的客户份额；CLV的直接敌人。

segments.src: - **ROAS (Return on Ad Spend)** — revenue generated per dollar of advertising, the standard scorecard of performance marketing.
segments.tr: - **ROAS (Return on Ad Spend)** — 每美元广告费产生的收入，效果营销的标准记分卡。

segments.src: - **CRM** — both the practice of managing customer relationships over time and the software that centralizes each customer's history so those relationships can be acted on at scale.
segments.tr: - **CRM** — 既是随着时间管理客户关系的实践，又是集中每个客户历史记录的软件，以便可以大规模地对这些关系采取行动。

segments.src: *Answers: 1 — (b).
At 1.2:1 there's almost no margin left to cover overhead, product development, or mistakes; growth like this consumes cash rather than generating it.
segments.tr: 在 1.2:1 的比例下，几乎没有留下任何利润来支付管理费用、产品开发或错误；这样的增长消耗现金而不是产生现金。

segments.src: Retention is the "years retained" term in the CLV formula, and stretching it costs nothing in media spend.
segments.tr: 留存是 CLV 公式中的“留存年限”项，延长它在媒体支出上不花任何钱。

segments.src: A CRM is a system of record that makes targeted action possible; proving causation requires an incrementality test with a holdout group, not a CRM.*
segments.tr: CRM 是一个使目标行动成为可能的记录系统；证明因果关系需要一个带有对照组的增量测试，而不是 CRM。*

es.title: [Marketing 101 #13] El cliente más barato que jamás comprarás es el que ya tienes

segments.src: > Modern marketing runs on two questions: what is a customer worth over their whole relationship with you, and how much did it cost to get them? Everything else — the CRM, the dashboards, the ad spend — exists to answer those two.
segments.tr: > El marketing moderno se basa en dos preguntas: ¿cuánto vale un cliente a lo largo de toda su relación contigo y cuánto costó conseguirlo? Todo lo demás —el CRM, los paneles de control, el gasto en publicidad— existe para responder a esas dos.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## Concepto de hoy

segments.src: For most of the 20th century, marketing was measured in *transactions*.
segments.tr: Durante la mayor parte del siglo XX, el marketing se medía en *transacciones*.

segments.src: You ran a campaign, sales went up or they didn't, and you moved on.
segments.tr: Lanzabas una campaña, las ventas subían o no, y seguías adelante.

segments.src: Data-driven marketing swaps the unit of measurement from the transaction to the **relationship**.
segments.tr: El marketing basado en datos cambia la unidad de medida de la transacción a la **relación**.

segments.src: The core number is **customer lifetime value (CLV, sometimes LTV)** — the total profit you expect from one customer across the entire time they stay with you.
segments.tr: La cifra fundamental es el **valor de vida del cliente (CLV, a veces LTV)**: el beneficio total que esperas obtener de un cliente durante todo el tiempo que permanezca contigo.

segments.src: For a repeat-purchase business, the plain-English version looks like this:
segments.tr: Para un negocio de compras recurrentes, la versión en lenguaje sencillo se ve así:

segments.src: CLV = average order value  x  orders per year  x  gross margin  x  years retained
segments.tr: CLV = average order value  x  orders per year  x  gross margin  x  years retained

segments.src: Set that next to what it cost to win the customer — **customer acquisition cost (CAC)**, which is total sales and marketing spend divided by new customers acquired — and you get the ratio that quietly governs a lot of business decisions:
segments.tr: Si comparas eso con lo que costó ganar al cliente —el **coste de adquisición de clientes (CAC)**, que es el gasto total en ventas y marketing dividido por los nuevos clientes adquiridos— obtienes la proporción que gobierna silenciosamente muchas decisiones empresariales:

segments.src: LTV : CAC
segments.tr: LTV : CAC

segments.src: The common rule of thumb in subscription and DTC businesses is that a healthy ratio is around 3:1.
segments.tr: La regla general en los negocios de suscripción y DTC es que una proporción saludable es de alrededor de 3:1.

segments.src: That number is a heuristic, not a law of nature — a business with fat margins and cheap servicing can survive on less; one with heavy fulfillment costs needs more.
segments.tr: Ese número es una heurística, no una ley natural: una empresa con márgenes amplios y un servicio barato puede sobrevivir con menos; una con costes de cumplimiento elevados necesita más.

segments.src: The useful part isn't the magic number.
segments.tr: La parte útil no es el número mágico.

segments.src: It's the realization that **you can improve the ratio from either side**: spend less to acquire, or keep people longer.
segments.tr: Es darse cuenta de que **puedes mejorar la proporción desde cualquiera de los dos lados**: gastar menos en adquirir o retener a la gente durante más tiempo.

segments.src: Two disciplines sit on either side of that ratio.
segments.tr: Dos disciplinas se sitúan a cada lado de esa proporción.

segments.src: **Performance marketing** works the CAC side.
segments.tr: **El marketing de resultados (Performance marketing)** trabaja el lado del CAC.

segments.src: It's advertising bought and judged on measurable outcomes — clicks, signups, purchases — rather than on impressions or brand sentiment.
segments.tr: Es publicidad comprada y juzgada por resultados medibles —clics, registros, compras— en lugar de por impresiones o sentimiento de marca.

segments.src: Its native metrics are CAC and **ROAS** (revenue divided by ad spend).
segments.tr: Sus métricas nativas son el CAC y el **ROAS** (ingresos divididos por el gasto en publicidad).

segments.src: Its superpower is fast feedback; you can kill a bad ad in a day.
segments.tr: Su superpoder es la retroalimentación rápida; puedes eliminar un anuncio malo en un día.

segments.src: **CRM** — customer relationship management — works the retention side.
segments.tr: **CRM** —gestión de relaciones con los clientes— trabaja el lado de la retención.

segments.src: The phrase means two things at once: the *practice* of managing customer relationships deliberately, and the *software* (Salesforce, HubSpot, Klaviyo, and dozens more) that stores every customer's purchases, emails, support tickets, and behavior in one record.
segments.tr: La frase significa dos cosas a la vez: la *práctica* de gestionar las relaciones con los clientes de forma deliberada y el *software* (Salesforce, HubSpot, Klaviyo y docenas más) que almacena las compras, correos electrónicos, tickets de soporte y comportamiento de cada cliente en un solo registro.

segments.src: The software matters because it turns "we should really follow up with lapsed buyers" into a query you can actually run and a message you can actually send.
segments.tr: El software importa porque convierte el "realmente deberíamos hacer un seguimiento de los compradores que han dejado de comprar" en una consulta que realmente puedes ejecutar y un mensaje que realmente puedes enviar.

segments.src: One honest caveat before the example: these systems measure *correlation with* a sale, not *cause of* a sale.
segments.tr: Una advertencia honesta antes del ejemplo: estos sistemas miden la *correlación con* una venta, no la *causa de* una venta.

segments.src: A returning customer who was going to buy anyway may click your retargeting ad on the way — and the ad gets the credit.
segments.tr: Un cliente recurrente que iba a comprar de todos modos puede hacer clic en tu anuncio de retargeting en el camino, y el anuncio se lleva el crédito.

segments.src: Privacy changes across browsers and mobile platforms over the past several years have also made click-level tracking less complete than the dashboards imply.
segments.tr: Los cambios de privacidad en los navegadores y plataformas móviles durante los últimos años también han hecho que el seguimiento a nivel de clic sea menos completo de lo que sugieren los paneles de control.

segments.src: Serious teams check their attribution numbers against **incrementality tests** — holding ads back from a randomized region or audience and comparing sales to a region that still sees them.
segments.tr: Los equipos serios verifican sus números de atribución frente a **pruebas de incrementalidad**: reteniendo anuncios de una región o audiencia aleatoria y comparando las ventas con una región que todavía los ve.

segments.src: It's the closest thing marketing has to a control group.
segments.tr: Es lo más parecido que tiene el marketing a un grupo de control.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## En la vida cotidiana

segments.src: Take Cedar & Co., a small coffee roaster in Denver selling 12 oz bags online at $18, with a 40% gross margin.
segments.tr: Tomemos a Cedar & Co., un pequeño tostador de café en Denver que vende bolsas de 12 oz en línea a $18, con un margen bruto del 40%.

segments.src: They run Meta and Google ads and pay about **$45 to acquire each new customer**.
segments.tr: Ejecutan anuncios en Meta y Google y pagan alrededor de **$45 para adquirir cada nuevo cliente**.

segments.src: Their typical subscriber orders once a month and sticks around 18 months.
segments.tr: Su suscriptor típico pide una vez al mes y se queda unos 18 meses.

segments.src: CLV = $18 x 12 orders/yr x 0.40 margin x 1.5 years = $129.60
segments.tr: CLV = $18 x 12 orders/yr x 0.40 margin x 1.5 years = $129.60

segments.src: Workable, not comfortable.
segments.tr: Viable, no cómodo.

segments.src: The founder's instinct is to fix it by finding cheaper ads.
segments.tr: El instinto del fundador es arreglarlo encontrando anuncios más baratos.

segments.src: But look what happens if their CRM data does the work instead.
segments.tr: Pero mira lo que sucede si los datos del CRM hacen el trabajo en su lugar.

segments.src: Digging into the customer records, they notice a pattern: most cancellations cluster right after month five, and those customers had never tried anything but the house blend.
segments.tr: Al profundizar en los registros de clientes, notan un patrón: la mayoría de las cancelaciones se agrupan justo después del quinto mes, y esos clientes nunca habían probado nada más que la mezcla de la casa.

segments.src: So they set up an automated CRM flow — at month four, anyone who's only ever ordered one product gets an email with a free single-origin sample in their next box.
segments.tr: Así que configuran un flujo de CRM automatizado: al cuarto mes, cualquiera que solo haya pedido un producto recibe un correo electrónico con una muestra gratuita de origen único en su próxima caja.

segments.src: Say that pushes average retention from 18 months to 24:
segments.tr: Digamos que eso aumenta la retención promedio de 18 meses a 24:

segments.src: Same ad budget.
segments.tr: Mismo presupuesto publicitario.

segments.src: Same CAC.
segments.tr: Mismo CAC.

segments.src: A 33% jump in customer value, bought with an email and a sample bag.
segments.tr: Un salto del 33% en el valor del cliente, comprado con un correo electrónico y una bolsa de muestra.

segments.src: That's the whole argument for CRM in one example.
segments.tr: Ese es todo el argumento a favor del CRM en un ejemplo.

segments.src: Performance marketing can usually shave CAC by maybe 10–20% before you hit the floor of what a click costs in a competitive auction.
segments.tr: El marketing de resultados generalmente puede reducir el CAC quizás un 10-20% antes de alcanzar el límite de lo que cuesta un clic en una subasta competitiva.

segments.src: Retention has far more headroom — and unlike your ad account, no competitor can bid it away from you.
segments.tr: La retención tiene mucho más margen de maniobra y, a diferencia de tu cuenta publicitaria, ningún competidor puede quitártela mediante pujas.

segments.src: The flip side is real too: if Cedar & Co.
segments.tr: La otra cara de la moneda también es real: si Cedar & Co.

segments.src: had lousy coffee, no CRM flow would save them.
segments.tr: tuviera un café pésimo, ningún flujo de CRM los salvaría.

segments.src: Retention work amplifies a product people want.
segments.tr: El trabajo de retención amplifica un producto que la gente quiere.

segments.src: It does not manufacture one.
segments.tr: No fabrica uno.

segments.tr: مقاييسه الأصلية هي تكلفة الاكتساب و**ROAS** (الإيرادات مقسومة على الإنفاق الإعلاني).

segments.src: Its superpower is fast feedback; you can kill a bad ad in a day.
segments.tr: قوته الخارقة هي ردود الفعل السريعة؛ يمكنك قتل إعلان سيء في يوم واحد.

segments.src: **CRM** — customer relationship management — works the retention side.
segments.tr: **إدارة علاقات العملاء (CRM)** — إدارة علاقات العملاء — تعمل على جانب الاحتفاظ.

segments.src: The phrase means two things at once: the *practice* of managing customer relationships deliberately, and the *software* (Salesforce, HubSpot, Klaviyo, and dozens more) that stores every customer's purchases, emails, support tickets, and behavior in one record.
segments.tr: تعني العبارة شيئين في نفس الوقت: *ممارسة* إدارة علاقات العملاء بشكل متعمد، و*البرمجيات* (Salesforce، HubSpot، Klaviyo، وعشرات أخرى) التي تخزن مشتريات كل عميل، ورسائل البريد الإلكتروني، وتذاكر الدعم، والسلوك في سجل واحد.

segments.src: The software matters because it turns "we should really follow up with lapsed buyers" into a query you can actually run and a message you can actually send.
segments.tr: أهمية البرمجيات تكمن في أنها تحول "يجب حقاً أن نتابع مع المشترين الذين توقفوا" إلى استعلام يمكنك تشغيله حقاً ورسالة يمكنك إرسالها حقاً.

segments.src: One honest caveat before the example: these systems measure *correlation with* a sale, not *cause of* a sale.
segments.tr: تحذير واحد صادق قبل المثال: تقيس هذه الأنظمة *الارتباط بـ* عملية بيع، وليس *سبب* عملية بيع.

segments.src: A returning customer who was going to buy anyway may click your retargeting ad on the way — and the ad gets the credit.
segments.tr: العميل العائد الذي كان سيشتري على أي حال قد ينقر على إعلان إعادة الاستهداف الخاص بك في الطريق — ويحصل الإعلان على الفضل.

segments.src: Privacy changes across browsers and mobile platforms over the past several years have also made click-level tracking less complete than the dashboards imply.
segments.tr: التغييرات في الخصوصية عبر المتصفحات ومنصات الهاتف المحمول على مدى السنوات القليلة الماضية جعلت تتبع مستوى النقر أقل اكتمالاً مما تشير إليه لوحات المعلومات.

segments.src: Serious teams check their attribution numbers against **incrementality tests** — holding ads back from a randomized region or audience and comparing sales to a region that still sees them.
segments.tr: تتحقق الفرق الجادة من أرقام الإسناد الخاصة بهم مقابل **اختبارات التزايد** — حجب الإاعات عن منطقة عشوائية أو جمهور ومقارنة المبيعات بمنطقة لا تزال تشاهدها.

segments.src: It's the closest thing marketing has to a control group.
segments.tr: إنه أقرب شيء يمتلكه التسويق إلى مجموعة التحكم.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## في الحياة اليومية

segments.src: Take Cedar & Co., a small coffee roaster in Denver selling 12 oz bags online at $18, with a 40% gross margin.
segments.tr: خذ Cedar & Co.، محمصة قهوة صغيرة في دنفر تبيع أكياس بوزن 12 أونصة عبر الإنترنت بسعر 18 دولاراً، مع هامش إجمالي بنسبة 40%.

segments.src: They run Meta and Google ads and pay about **$45 to acquire each new customer**.
segments.tr: يديرون إعلانات ميتا وجوجل ويدفعون حوالي **45 دولاراً لاكتساب كل عميل جديد**.

segments.src: Their typical subscriber orders once a month and sticks around 18 months.
segments.tr: مشتركهم النموذجي يطلب مرة واحدة في الشهر ويبقى حوالي 18 شهراً.

segments.src: CLV = $18 x 12 orders/yr x 0.40 margin x 1.5 years = $129.60
segments.tr: CLV = $18 x 12 orders/yr x 0.40 margin x 1.5 years = $129.60

segments.src: Workable, not comfortable.
segments.tr: قابل للتنفيذ، وليس مريحاً.

segments.src: The founder's instinct is to fix it by finding cheaper ads.
segments.tr: غريزة المؤسس هي إصلاح ذلك من خلال العثور على إعلانات أرخص.

segments.src: But look what happens if their CRM data does the work instead.
segments.tr: ولكن انظر ما يحدث إذا قامت بيانات CRM بالعمل بدلاً من ذلك.

segments.src: Digging into the customer records, they notice a pattern: most cancellations cluster right after month five, and those customers had never tried anything but the house blend.
segments.tr: بالتعمق في سجلات العملاء، يلاحظون نمطاً: معظم عمليات الإلغاء تتجمع مباشرة بعد الشهر الخامس، وهؤلاء العملاء لم يجرّبوا قط سوى مزيج الدار.

segments.src: So they set up an automated CRM flow — at month four, anyone who's only ever ordered one product gets an email with a free single-origin sample in their next box.
segments.tr: لذلك يقومون بإعداد تدفق CRM تلقائي — في الشهر الرابع، يتلقى أي شخص طلب منتجاً واحداً فقط رسالة بريد إلكتروني تحتوي على عينة أصل واحد مجانية في صندوقه التالي.

segments.src: Say that pushes average retention from 18 months to 24:
segments.tr: قل إن ذلك يدفع متوسط الاحتفاظ من 18 شهراً إلى 24:

segments.src: Same ad budget.
segments.tr: نفس ميزانية الإعلانات.

segments.src: Same CAC.
segments.tr: نفس تكلفة الاكتساب.

segments.src: A 33% jump in customer value, bought with an email and a sample bag.
segments.tr: قفزة بنسبة 33% في قيمة العميل، تم شراؤها ببريد إلكتروني وكيس عينة.

segments.src: That's the whole argument for CRM in one example.
segments.tr: هذه هي الحجة الكاملة لإدارة علاقات العملاء في مثال واحد.

segments.src: Performance marketing can usually shave CAC by maybe 10–20% before you hit the floor of what a click costs in a competitive auction.
segments.tr: عادة ما يمكن للتسويق القائم على الأداء تقليل تكلفة الاكتساب بنسبة 10-20% ربما قبل أن تصل إلى الحد الأدنى لتكلفة النقر في مزاد تنافسي.

segments.src: Retention has far more headroom — and unlike your ad account, no competitor can bid it away from you.
segments.tr: الاحتفاظ لديه مساحة أكبر بكثير — وعكس حساب إعلانك، لا يمكن لأي منافس المزايدة عليه بعيداً عنك.

segments.src: The flip side is real too: if Cedar & Co.
segments.tr: الجانب الآخر حقيقي أيضاً: إذا كان لدى Cedar & Co.

segments.src: had lousy coffee, no CRM flow would save them.
segments.tr: قهوة سيئة، فلن ينقذهم أي تدفق CRM.

segments.src: Retention work amplifies a product people want.
segments.tr: عمل الاحتفاظ يعزز منتجاً يريده الناس.

segments.src: It does not manufacture one.
segments.tr: إنه لا يصنع واحداً.

segments.src: ## Three-Line Summary
segments.tr: ## ملخص من ثلاثة أسطر

segments.src: 1. **CLV** is the profit a customer generates over the whole relationship; compared against **CAC**, it tells you whether growth is actually creating value or just buying revenue.
segments.tr: 1. **CLV** هو الربح الذي يولده العميل طوال العلاقة بأكملها؛ مقارنة بـ **CAC**، فإنه يخبرك ما إذا كان النمو يخلق قيمة حقاً أم مجرد شراء إيرادات.

segments.src: 2. **Performance marketing** lowers the cost of acquiring customers; **CRM** raises what each one is worth — and retention usually has more room to move.
segments.tr: **التسويق الأداء** يقلل من تكلفة اكتساب العملاء؛ **CRM** يرفع ما يستحقه كل واحد — والاحتفاظ عادة ما يكون لديه مساحة أكبر للتحرك.

segments.src: 3. Dashboards show correlation, not causation, so test your ad claims against a holdout before you trust them.
segments.tr: تظهر لوحات المعلومات الارتباط وليس السببية، لذا اختبر مطالبات إعلاناتك مقابل مجموعة محجوزة قبل أن تثق بها.

segments.src: ## ✅ Self Quiz
segments.tr: ## ✅ اختبار الذات

segments.src: **1.** A company reports an LTV:CAC ratio of 1.2:1.
segments.tr: **1.** تسجل شركة نسبة LTV:CAC تبلغ 1.2:1.

segments.src: What does that most likely mean?
segments.tr: ماذا يعني ذلك على الأرجح؟

segments.src: - (a) The business is healthy and should spend more on ads
segments.tr: - (أ) العمل بصحة جيدة ويجب أن ينفق أكثر على الإعلانات

segments.src: - (b) It costs nearly as much to acquire a customer as that customer will ever return in profit
segments.tr: - (ب) يكلف اكتساب عميل تقريباً نفس ما سيعود به هذا العميل من ربح على الإطلاق

segments.src: - (c) The CRM system is misconfigured
segments.tr: - (ج) تم تكوين نظام CRM بشكل خاطئ

segments.src: - (d) Gross margin is too high
segments.tr: - (د) الهامش الإجمالي مرتفع للغاية

segments.src: **2.** (O/X) Improving customer retention can raise CLV without increasing ad spend at all.
segments.tr: **2.** (ص/خ) تحسين الاحتفاظ بالعملاء يمكن أن يرفع CLV دون زيادة الإنفاق الإعلاني على الإطلاق.

segments.src: **3.** Which of these is a CRM system best suited for?
segments.tr: **3.** أي من هذه هو الأنسب لنظام CRM؟

segments.src: - (a) Proving that a specific ad campaign *caused* a sale
segments.tr: - (أ) إثبات أن حملة إعلانية محددة *تسببت في* عملية بيع

segments.src: - (b) Setting the optimal price for a product
segments.tr: - (ب) تحديد السعر الأمثل لمنتج

segments.src: - (c) Keeping one shared record of each customer's history so teams can act on it
segments.tr: - (ج) الاحتفاظ بسجل مشترك واحد لتاريخ كل عميل حتى تتمكن الفرق من التصرف بناءً عليه

segments.src: - (d) Replacing the need for a marketing strategy
segments.tr: - (د) استبدال الحاجة إلى استراتيجية تسويق

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 شروط اليوم

segments.src: - **Customer Lifetime Value (CLV / LTV)** — the total profit a business expects from a single customer over the full length of the relationship.
segments.tr: - **القيمة الدائمة للعميل (CLV / LTV)** — إجمالي الربح الذي يتوقعه النشاط التجاري من عميل واحد طوال فترة العلاقة بالكامل.

segments.src: - **Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC)** — total sales and marketing spend divided by the number of new customers it produced.
segments.tr: - **تكلفة اكتساب العميل (CAC)** — إجمالي الإنفاق على المبيعات والتسويق مقسوماً على عدد العملاء الجدد الذين أنتجتهم.

segments.src: - **Churn Rate** — the share of customers who stop buying or cancel in a given period; the direct enemy of CLV.
segments.tr: - **معدل التخلي (Churn Rate)** — نسبة العملاء الذين يتوقفون عن الشراء أو يلغون في فترة معينة؛ العدو اللدود لـ CLV.

segments.src: - **ROAS (Return on Ad Spend)** — revenue generated per dollar of advertising, the standard scorecard of performance marketing.
segments.tr: - **ROAS (العائد على الإنفاق الإعلاني)** — الإيرادات الناتجة لكل دولار من الإعلانات، بطاقة الأداء القياسية للتسويق الأداء.

segments.src: - **CRM** — both the practice of managing customer relationships over time and the software that centralizes each customer's history so those relationships can be acted on at scale.
segments.tr: - **CRM** — كل من ممارسة إدارة علاقات العملاء بمرور الوقت والبرمجيات التي تركز تاريخ كل عميل حتى يمكن التصرف في هذه العلاقات على نطاق واسع.

segments.src: *Answers: 1 — (b).
segments.tr: *الإجابات: 1 — (ب).

segments.src: At 1.2:1 there's almost no margin left to cover overhead, product development, or mistakes; growth like this consumes cash rather than generating it.
segments.tr: عند 1.2:1 لا يوجد تقريباً أي هامش متبقي لتغطية النفقات العامة، أو تطوير المنتجات، أو الأخطاء؛ النمو مثل هذا يستهلك النقد بدلاً من توليده.

segments.src: Retention is the "years retained" term in the CLV formula, and stretching it costs nothing in media spend.
segments.tr: الاحتفاظ هو مصطلح "سنوات الاحتفاظ" في صيغة CLV، وتمديده لا يكلف شيئاً في إنفاق وسائل الإعلام.

segments.src: A CRM is a system of record that makes targeted action possible; proving causation requires an incrementality test with a holdout group, not a CRM.*
segments.tr: CRM هو نظام تسجيل يجعل الإجراءات المستهدفة ممكنة؛ إثبات السببية يتطلب اختبار تزايد مع مجموعة محجوزة، وليس CRM.*

fr.title: [Marketing 101 #13] Le client le moins cher que vous n'achèterez jamais est celui que vous avez déjà

segments.src: > Modern marketing runs on two questions: what is a customer worth over their whole relationship with you, and how much did it cost to get them? Everything else — the CRM, the dashboards, the ad spend — exists to answer those two.
segments.tr: > Le marketing moderne repose sur deux questions : quelle est la valeur d'un client sur l'ensemble de sa relation avec vous, and combien a-t-il coûté pour l'acquérir ? Tout le reste — le CRM, les tableaux de bord, les dépenses publicitaires — existe pour répondre à ces deux-là.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## Le concept du jour

segments.src: For most of the 20th century, marketing was measured in *transactions*.
segments.tr: Pendant la majeure partie du XXe siècle, le marketing se mesurait en *transactions*.

segments.src: You ran a campaign, sales went up or they didn't, and you moved on.
segments.tr: Vous lanciez une campagne, les ventes augmentaient ou non, and vous passiez à autre chose.

segments.src: Data-driven marketing swaps the unit of measurement from the transaction to the **relationship**.
segments.tr: Le marketing axé sur les données fait passer l'unité de mesure de la transaction à la **relation**.

segments.src: The core number is **customer lifetime value (CLV, sometimes LTV)** — the total profit you expect from one customer across the entire time they stay with you.
segments.tr: Le chiffre clé est la **valeur vie client (CLV, parfois LTV)** — le profit total que vous attendez d'un client sur toute la durée de son séjour chez vous.

segments.src: For a repeat-purchase business, the plain-English version looks like this:
segments.tr: Pour une entreprise à achats répétés, la version en clair donne ceci :

segments.src: CLV = average order value  x  orders per year  x  gross margin  x  years retained
segments.tr: CLV = average order value  x  orders per year  x  gross margin  x  years retained

segments.src: Set that next to what it cost to win the customer — **customer acquisition cost (CAC)**, which is total sales and marketing spend divided by new customers acquired — and you get the ratio that quietly governs a lot of business decisions:
segments.tr: Mettez cela en regard de ce qu'a coûté l'acquisition du client — le **coût d'acquisition client (CAC)**, qui correspond aux dépenses totales de vente et de marketing divisées par les nouveaux clients acquis — and vous obtenez le ratio qui régit discrètement de nombreuses décisions commerciales :

segments.src: LTV : CAC
segments.tr: LTV : CAC

segments.src: The common rule of thumb in subscription and DTC businesses is that a healthy ratio is around 3:1.
segments.tr: La règle empirique courante dans les entreprises par abonnement et DTC est qu'un ratio sain se situe autour de 3:1.

segments.src: That number is a heuristic, not a law of nature — a business with fat margins and cheap servicing can survive on less; one with heavy fulfillment costs needs more.
segments.tr: Ce chiffre est une heuristique, pas une loi de la nature — une entreprise avec des marges confortables and un service bon marché peut survivre avec moins ; une autre avec de lourds coûts d'exécution en a besoin de plus.

segments.src: The useful part isn't the magic number.
segments.tr: La partie utile n'est pas le chiffre magique.

segments.src: It's the realization that **you can improve the ratio from either side**: spend less to acquire, or keep people longer.
segments.tr: C'est la prise de conscience que **vous pouvez améliorer le ratio des deux côtés** : dépenser moins pour acquérir, ou garder les gens plus longtemps.

segments.src: Two disciplines sit on either side of that ratio.
segments.tr: Deux disciplines se trouvent de chaque côté de ce ratio.

segments.src: **Performance marketing** works the CAC side.
segments.tr: Le **marketing à la performance** travaille sur l'aspect du CAC.

segments.src: It's advertising bought and judged on measurable outcomes — clicks, signups, purchases — rather than on impressions or brand sentiment.
segments.tr: Il s'agit de publicités achetées and jugées sur des résultats mesurables — clics, inscriptions, achats — plutôt que sur les impressions ou le sentiment de marque.

segments.src: Its native metrics are CAC and **ROAS** (revenue divided by ad spend).
segments.tr: Ses métriques natives sont le CAC and le **ROAS** (revenu divisé par les dépenses publicitaires).

segments.src: Its superpower is fast feedback; you can kill a bad ad in a day.
segments.tr: Son super-pouvoir est un retour rapide ; vous pouvez tuer une mauvaise publicité en un jour.

segments.src: **CRM** — customer relationship management — works the retention side.
segments.tr: Le **CRM** — la gestion de la relation client — travaille sur l'aspect de la fidélisation.

segments.src: The phrase means two things at once: the *practice* of managing customer relationships deliberately, and the *software* (Salesforce, HubSpot, Klaviyo, and dozens more) that stores every customer's purchases, emails, support tickets, and behavior in one record.
segments.tr: Cette expression signifie deux choses à la fois : la *pratique* de la gestion délibérée des relations clients, and le *logiciel* (Salesforce, HubSpot, Klaviyo, and des dizaines d'autres) qui stocke les achats, e-mails, tickets de support and comportements de chaque client dans un seul dossier.

segments.src: The software matters because it turns "we should really follow up with lapsed buyers" into a query you can actually run and a message you can actually send.
segments.tr: Le logiciel compte parce qu'il transforme "nous devrions vraiment relancer les acheteurs inactifs" en une requête que vous pouvez réellement exécuter and un message que vous pouvez réellement envoyer.

segments.src: One honest caveat before the example: these systems measure *correlation with* a sale, not *cause of* a sale.
segments.tr: Une mise en garde honnête avant l'exemple : ces systèmes mesurent la *corrélation avec* une vente, and non la *cause d'*une vente.

segments.src: A returning customer who was going to buy anyway may click your retargeting ad on the way — and the ad gets the credit.
segments.tr: Un client récurrent qui allait de toute façon acheter peut cliquer sur votre annonce de reciblage en chemin — and l'annonce en récolte le mérite.

segments.src: Privacy changes across browsers and mobile platforms over the past several years have also made click-level tracking less complete than the dashboards imply.
segments.tr: Les modifications de confidentialité sur les navigateurs and les plates-formes mobiles au cours des dernières années ont également rendu le suivi au niveau des clics moins complet que ne le laissent entendre les tableaux de bord.

segments.src: Serious teams check their attribution numbers against **incrementality tests** — holding ads back from a randomized region or audience and comparing sales to a region that still sees them.
segments.tr: Les équipes sérieuses vérifient leurs chiffres d'attribution par rapport à des **tests d'incrémentalité** — en retenant les publicités d'une région ou d'un public aléatoire and en comparant les ventes à une région qui les voit toujours.

segments.src: It's the closest thing marketing has to a control group.
segments.tr: C'est ce qui se rapproche le plus d'un groupe témoin en marketing.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## Dans la vie de tous les jours

segments.tr: Prenez Cedar & Co., un petit torréfacteur de café à Denver qui vend des sacs de 12 oz en ligne à 18 $, avec une marge brute de 40 %.

segments.tr: Leur abonné type commande une fois par mois and reste environ 18 mois.

segments.tr: CLV = $18 x 12 orders/yr x 0.40 margin x 1.5 years = $129.60

segments.src: Workable, not comfortable.
segments.tr: Gérable, mais pas confortable.

segments.src: The founder's instinct is to fix it by finding cheaper ads.
segments.tr: L'instinct du fondateur est de régler le problème en trouvant des publicités moins chères.

segments.src: But look what happens if their CRM data does the work instead.
segments.tr: Mais regardez ce qui se passe si leurs données CRM font le travail à la place.

segments.src: Digging into the customer records, they notice a pattern: most cancellations cluster right after month five, and those customers had never tried anything but the house blend.
segments.tr: En fouillant dans les dossiers clients, ils remarquent un schéma : la plupart des annulations se regroupent juste après le cinquième mois, and ces clients n'avaient jamais essayé autre chose que le mélange maison.

segments.src: So they set up an automated CRM flow — at month four, anyone who's only ever ordered one product gets an email with a free single-origin sample in their next box.

segments.src: Say that pushes average retention from 18 months to 24:

segments.src: Same ad budget.
segments.tr: Même budget publicitaire.

segments.tr: Un bond de 33 % de la valeur client, acheté avec un e-mail and un sac d'échantillons.

segments.src: That's the whole argument for CRM in one example.
segments.tr: C'est tout l'argument du CRM en un seul exemple.

segments.src: Performance marketing can usually shave CAC by maybe 10–20% before you hit the floor of what a click costs in a competitive auction.
segments.tr: Le marketing à la performance peut généralement réduire le CAC d'environ 10 à 20 % avant d'atteindre le plancher du coût d'un clic dans une enchère compétitive.

pt.title: [Marketing 101 #13] O cliente mais barato que você comprará é aquele que você já tem

segments.src: > Modern marketing runs on two questions: what is a customer worth over their whole relationship with you, and how much did it cost to get them? Everything else — the CRM, the dashboards, the ad spend — exists to answer those two.
segments.tr: > O marketing moderno gira em torno de duas perguntas: quanto vale um cliente ao longo de todo o seu relacionamento com você e quanto custou adquiri-lo? Todo o resto — o CRM, os dashboards, o gasto com anúncios — existe para responder a essas duas perguntas.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## Conceito de hoje

segments.src: For most of the 20th century, marketing was measured in *transactions*.
segments.tr: Durante a maior parte do século XX, o marketing era medido em *transações*.

segments.src: You ran a campaign, sales went up or they didn't, and you moved on.
segments.tr: Você fazia uma campanha, as vendas aumentavam ou não, e você seguia em frente.

segments.src: Data-driven marketing swaps the unit of measurement from the transaction to the **relationship**.
segments.tr: O marketing orientado a dados troca a unidade de medida da transação pelo **relacionamento**.

segments.src: The core number is **customer lifetime value (CLV, sometimes LTV)** — the total profit you expect from one customer across the entire time they stay with you.
segments.tr: O número central é o **valor do tempo de vida do cliente (CLV, às vezes LTV)** — o lucro total que você espera de um cliente durante todo o tempo em que ele permanece com você.

segments.src: For a repeat-purchase business, the plain-English version looks like this:
segments.tr: Para um negócio de compras recorrentes, a versão em linguagem simples é assim:

segments.src: CLV = average order value  x  orders per year  x  gross margin  x  years retained
segments.tr: CLV = average order value  x  orders per year  x  gross margin  x  years retained

segments.src: Set that next to what it cost to win the customer — **customer acquisition cost (CAC)**, which is total sales and marketing spend divided by new customers acquired — and you get the ratio that quietly governs a lot of business decisions:
segments.tr: Coloque isso ao lado do que custou para conquistar o cliente — **custo de aquisição de cliente (CAC)**, que é o total de gastos com vendas e marketing dividido pelos novos clientes adquiridos — e você obtém a proporção que governa silenciosamente muitas decisões de negócios:

segments.src: LTV : CAC
segments.tr: LTV : CAC

segments.src: The common rule of thumb in subscription and DTC businesses is that a healthy ratio is around 3:1.
segments.tr: A regra prática comum em negócios de assinatura e DTC é que uma proporção saudável é de cerca de 3:1.

segments.src: That number is a heuristic, not a law of nature — a business with fat margins and cheap servicing can survive on less; one with heavy fulfillment costs needs more.
segments.tr: Esse número é uma heurística, não uma lei da natureza — um negócio com margens altas e atendimento barato pode sobreviver com menos; um com custos de atendimento pesados precisa de mais.

segments.src: The useful part isn't the magic number.
segments.tr: A parte útil não é o número mágico.

segments.src: It's the realization that **you can improve the ratio from either side**: spend less to acquire, or keep people longer.
segments.tr: É a percepção de que **você pode melhorar a proporção de qualquer um dos lados**: gastar menos para adquirir ou manter as pessoas por mais tempo.

segments.src: Two disciplines sit on either side of that ratio.
segments.tr: Duas disciplinas ficam de cada lado dessa proporção.

segments.src: **Performance marketing** works the CAC side.
segments.tr: **Performance marketing** trabalha o lado do CAC.

segments.src: It's advertising bought and judged on measurable outcomes — clicks, signups, purchases — rather than on impressions or brand sentiment.
segments.tr: É publicidade comprada e julgada com base em resultados mensuráveis — cliques, inscrições, compras — em vez de impressões ou sentimento de marca.

segments.src: Its native metrics are CAC and **ROAS** (revenue divided by ad spend).
segments.tr: Suas métricas nativas são CAC e **ROAS** (receita dividida pelo gasto com anúncios).

segments.src: Its superpower is fast feedback; you can kill a bad ad in a day.
segments.tr: Seu superpoder é o feedback rápido; você pode encerrar um anúncio ruim em um dia.

segments.src: **CRM** — customer relationship management — works the retention side.
segments.tr: **CRM** — gestão de relacionamento com o cliente — trabalha o lado da retenção.

segments.src: The phrase means two things at once: the *practice* of managing customer relationships deliberately, and the *software* (Salesforce, HubSpot, Klaviyo, and dozens more) that stores every customer's purchases, emails, support tickets, and behavior in one record.
segments.tr: A frase significa duas coisas ao mesmo tempo: a *prática* de gerenciar relacionamentos com clientes deliberadamente e o *software* (Salesforce, HubSpot, Klaviyo e dezenas de outros) que armazena as compras, e-mails, tickets de suporte e comportamento de cada cliente em um único registro.

segments.src: The software matters because it turns "we should really follow up with lapsed buyers" into a query you can actually run and a message you can actually send.
segments.tr: O software é importante porque transforma "deveríamos realmente acompanhar os compradores inativos" em uma consulta que você pode realmente executar e uma mensagem que você pode realmente enviar.

segments.src: One honest caveat before the example: these systems measure *correlation with* a sale, not *cause of* a sale.
segments.tr: Uma ressalva honesta antes do exemplo: esses sistemas medem a *correlação com* uma venda, não a *causa de* uma venda.

segments.src: A returning customer who was going to buy anyway may click your retargeting ad on the way — and the ad gets the credit.
segments.tr: Um cliente recorrente que compraria de qualquer maneira pode clicar no seu anúncio de retargeting no caminho — e o anúncio recebe o crédito.

segments.src: Privacy changes across browsers and mobile platforms over the past several years have also made click-level tracking less complete than the dashboards imply.
segments.tr: Mudanças de privacidade em navegadores e plataformas móveis nos últimos anos também tornaram o rastreamento em nível de clique menos completo do que os dashboards sugerem.

segments.src: Serious teams check their attribution numbers against **incrementality tests** — holding ads back from a randomized region or audience and comparing sales to a region that still sees them.
segments.tr: Equipes sérias verificam seus números de atribuição em relação a **testes de incrementalidade** — retendo anúncios de uma região ou público aleatório e comparando as vendas com uma região que ainda os vê.

segments.src: It's the closest thing marketing has to a control group.
segments.tr: É o mais próximo que o marketing tem de um grupo de controle.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## Na vida cotidiana

segments.src: Take Cedar & Co., a small coffee roaster in Denver selling 12 oz bags online at $18, with a 40% gross margin.
segments.tr: Pegue a Cedar & Co., uma pequena torrefação de café em Denver que vende pacotes de 12 oz online a $18, com uma margem bruta de 40%.

segments.src: They run Meta and Google ads and pay about **$45 to acquire each new customer**.
segments.tr: Eles veiculam anúncios no Meta e no Google e pagam cerca de **$45 para adquirir cada novo cliente**.

segments.src: Their typical subscriber orders once a month and sticks around 18 months.
segments.tr: Seu assinante típico faz pedidos uma vez por mês e permanece por 18 meses.

segments.src: CLV = $18 x 12 orders/yr x 0.40 margin x 1.5 years = $129.60
segments.tr: CLV = $18 x 12 orders/yr x 0.40 margin x 1.5 years = $129.60

segments.src: Workable, not comfortable.
segments.tr: Viável, não confortável.

segments.src: The founder's instinct is to fix it by finding cheaper ads.
segments.tr: O instinto do fundador é consertar isso encontrando anúncios mais baratos.

segments.src: But look what happens if their CRM data does the work instead.
segments.tr: Mas veja o que acontece se os dados do CRM fizerem o trabalho.

segments.src: Digging into the customer records, they notice a pattern: most cancellations cluster right after month five, and those customers had never tried anything but the house blend.
segments.tr: Ao analisar os registros dos clientes, eles notam um padrão: a maioria dos cancelamentos ocorre logo após o quinto mês, e esses clientes nunca tinham experimentado nada além do blend da casa.

segments.src: So they set up an automated CRM flow — at month four, anyone who's only ever ordered one product gets an email with a free single-origin sample in their next box.
segments.tr: Então, eles configuram um fluxo de CRM automatizado — no quarto mês, qualquer pessoa que só tenha pedido um produto recebe um e-mail com uma amostra de café de origem única gratuita em sua próxima caixa.

segments.src: Say that pushes average retention from 18 months to 24:
segments.tr: Digamos que isso aumente a retenção média de 18 meses para 24:

segments.src: Same ad budget.
segments.tr: Mesmo orçamento de anúncios.

segments.src: Same CAC.
segments.tr: Mesmo CAC.

segments.src: A 33% jump in customer value, bought with an email and a sample bag.
segments.tr: Um salto de 33% no valor do cliente, comprado com um e-mail e um pacote de amostra.

segments.src: That's the whole argument for CRM in one example.
segments.tr: Esse é todo o argumento a favor do CRM em um exemplo.

segments.src: Performance marketing can usually shave CAC by maybe 10–20% before you hit the floor of what a click costs in a competitive auction.
segments.tr: O marketing de performance geralmente consegue reduzir o CAC em talvez 10–20% antes de atingir o limite mínimo do custo de um clique em um leilão competitivo.

segments.src: Retention has far more headroom — and unlike your ad account, no competitor can bid it away from you.
segments.tr: A retenção tem muito mais espaço — e, ao contrário da sua conta de anúncios, nenhum concorrente pode tirá-la de você.

segments.src: The flip side is real too: if Cedar & Co.
segments.tr: O outro lado também é real: se a Cedar & Co.

segments.src: had lousy coffee, no CRM flow would save them.
segments.tr: tivesse um café ruim, nenhum fluxo de CRM os salvaria.

segments.src: Retention work amplifies a product people want.
segments.tr: O trabalho de retenção amplifica um produto que as pessoas desejam.

segments.src: It does not manufacture one.
segments.tr: Ele não fabrica um.
