in.title: [Marketing 101 #13] Pelanggan Termurah yang Akan Anda Dapatkan Adalah yang Sudah Anda Miliki

segments.src: > Modern marketing runs on two questions: what is a customer worth over their whole relationship with you, and how much did it cost to get them? Everything else — the CRM, the dashboards, the ad spend — exists to answer those two.
segments.tr: > Pemasaran modern berjalan di atas dua pertanyaan: berapa nilai seorang pelanggan selama keseluruhan hubungan mereka dengan Anda, dan berapa biaya untuk mendapatkannya? Segala hal lainnya — CRM, dasbor, pengeluaran iklan — ada untuk menjawab kedua pertanyaan tersebut.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## Konsep Hari Ini

segments.src: For most of the 20th century, marketing was measured in *transactions*.
segments.tr: Sebagian besar abad ke-20, pemasaran diukur dari *transaksi*.

segments.src: You ran a campaign, sales went up or they didn't, and you moved on.
segments.tr: Anda menjalankan kampanye, penjualan naik atau tidak, lalu Anda beralih ke hal lain.

segments.src: Data-driven marketing swaps the unit of measurement from the transaction to the **relationship**.
segments.tr: Pemasaran berbasis data mengalihkan satuan pengukuran dari transaksi ke **hubungan**.

segments.src: The core number is **customer lifetime value (CLV, sometimes LTV)** — the total profit you expect from one customer across the entire time they stay with you.
segments.tr: Angka intinya adalah **customer lifetime value (CLV, terkadang LTV)** — total keuntungan yang Anda harapkan dari satu pelanggan selama seluruh masa kebersamaan mereka dengan Anda.

segments.src: For a repeat-purchase business, the plain-English version looks like this:
segments.tr: Untuk bisnis dengan pembelian berulang, versi bahasa sederhananya terlihat seperti ini:

segments.src: CLV = average order value  x  orders per year  x  gross margin  x  years retained
segments.tr: CLV = average order value  x  orders per year  x  gross margin  x  years retained

segments.src: Set that next to what it cost to win the customer — **customer acquisition cost (CAC)**, which is total sales and marketing spend divided by new customers acquired — and you get the ratio that quietly governs a lot of business decisions:
segments.tr: Bandingkan itu dengan biaya untuk memenangkan pelanggan — **customer acquisition cost (CAC)**, yaitu total pengeluaran penjualan dan pemasaran dibagi dengan pelanggan baru yang didapat — dan Anda mendapatkan rasio yang diam-diam mengatur banyak keputusan bisnis:

segments.src: LTV : CAC
segments.tr: LTV : CAC

segments.src: The common rule of thumb in subscription and DTC businesses is that a healthy ratio is around 3:1.
segments.tr: Aturan praktis yang umum dalam bisnis langganan dan DTC adalah rasio yang sehat berada di sekitar 3:1.

segments.src: That number is a heuristic, not a law of nature — a business with fat margins and cheap servicing can survive on less; one with heavy fulfillment costs needs more.
segments.tr: Angka tersebut adalah heuristik, bukan hukum alam — bisnis dengan margin tebal dan biaya servis murah dapat bertahan dengan angka yang lebih rendah; bisnis dengan biaya pemenuhan yang berat membutuhkan lebih banyak.

segments.src: The useful part isn't the magic number.
segments.tr: Bagian yang berguna bukanlah angka ajaibnya.

segments.src: It's the realization that **you can improve the ratio from either side**: spend less to acquire, or keep people longer.
segments.tr: Melainkan kesadaran bahwa **Anda dapat memperbaiki rasio dari kedua sisi**: keluarkan lebih sedikit untuk mendapatkan pelanggan, atau pertahankan pelanggan lebih lama.

segments.src: Two disciplines sit on either side of that ratio.
segments.tr: Dua disiplin ilmu berada di setiap sisi rasio tersebut.

segments.src: **Performance marketing** works the CAC side.
segments.tr: **Performance marketing** bekerja di sisi CAC.

segments.src: It's advertising bought and judged on measurable outcomes — clicks, signups, purchases — rather than on impressions or brand sentiment.
segments.tr: Ini adalah iklan yang dibeli dan dinilai berdasarkan hasil yang dapat diukur — klik, pendaftaran, pembelian — alih-alih tayangan atau sentimen merek.

segments.src: Its native metrics are CAC and **ROAS** (revenue divided by ad spend).
segments.tr: Metrik aslinya adalah CAC dan **ROAS** (pendapatan dibagi pengeluaran iklan).

segments.src: Its superpower is fast feedback; you can kill a bad ad in a day.
segments.tr: Kekuatan utamanya adalah umpan balik yang cepat; Anda dapat menghentikan iklan yang buruk dalam sehari.

segments.src: **CRM** — customer relationship management — works the retention side.
segments.tr: **CRM** — manajemen hubungan pelanggan — bekerja di sisi retensi.

segments.src: The phrase means two things at once: the *practice* of managing customer relationships deliberately, and the *software* (Salesforce, HubSpot, Klaviyo, and dozens more) that stores every customer's purchases, emails, support tickets, and behavior in one record.
segments.tr: Frasa ini berarti dua hal sekaligus: *praktik* mengelola hubungan pelanggan secara sengaja, dan *perangkat lunak* (Salesforce, HubSpot, Klaviyo, dan lusinan lainnya) yang menyimpan pembelian, email, tiket dukungan, dan perilaku setiap pelanggan dalam satu catatan.

segments.src: The software matters because it turns "we should really follow up with lapsed buyers" into a query you can actually run and a message you can actually send.
segments.tr: Perangkat lunak ini penting karena mengubah "kita benar-benar harus menindaklanjuti pembeli yang tidak aktif" menjadi kueri yang benar-benar dapat Anda jalankan dan pesan yang benar-benar dapat Anda kirimkan.

segments.src: One honest caveat before the example: these systems measure *correlation with* a sale, not *cause of* a sale.
segments.tr: Satu peringatan jujur sebelum contoh: sistem ini mengukur *korelasi dengan* penjualan, bukan *penyebab dari* penjualan.

segments.src: A returning customer who was going to buy anyway may click your retargeting ad on the way — and the ad gets the credit.
segments.tr: Pelanggan setia yang tadinya akan tetap membeli mungkin mengeklik iklan penargetan ulang Anda di tengah jalan — dan iklan tersebut mendapatkan kreditnya.

segments.src: Privacy changes across browsers and mobile platforms over the past several years have also made click-level tracking less complete than the dashboards imply.
segments.tr: Perubahan privasi di berbagai peramban dan platform seluler selama beberapa tahun terakhir juga membuat pelacakan tingkat klik menjadi kurang lengkap dari yang tersirat di dasbor.

segments.src: Serious teams check their attribution numbers against **incrementality tests** — holding ads back from a randomized region or audience and comparing sales to a region that still sees them.
segments.tr: Tim yang serius memeriksa angka atribusi mereka terhadap **uji inkrementalisme** — menahan iklan dari wilayah atau audiens acak dan membandingkan penjualan dengan wilayah yang masih melihatnya.

segments.src: It's the closest thing marketing has to a control group.
segments.tr: Ini adalah hal paling mendekati kelompok kontrol yang dimiliki oleh pemasaran.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## Dalam Kehidupan Sehari-hari

segments.src: Take Cedar & Co., a small coffee roaster in Denver selling 12 oz bags online at $18, with a 40% gross margin.
segments.tr: Ambil contoh Cedar & Co., sebuah pemanggang kopi kecil di Denver yang menjual kemasan 12 ons secara online seharga $18, dengan margin kotor 40%.

segments.src: They run Meta and Google ads and pay about **$45 to acquire each new customer**.
segments.tr: Mereka menjalankan iklan Meta dan Google dan membayar sekitar **$45 untuk mendapatkan setiap pelanggan baru**.

segments.src: Their typical subscriber orders once a month and sticks around 18 months.
segments.tr: Pelanggan berlangganan khas mereka memesan sebulan sekali dan bertahan selama 18 bulan.

segments.src: CLV = $18 x 12 orders/yr x 0.40 margin x 1.5 years = $129.60
segments.tr: CLV = $18 x 12 orders/yr x 0.40 margin x 1.5 years = $129.60

segments.src: Workable, not comfortable.
segments.tr: Bisa dijalankan, tetapi tidak nyaman.

segments.src: The founder's instinct is to fix it by finding cheaper ads.
segments.tr: Naluri pendiri adalah memperbaikinya dengan mencari iklan yang lebih murah.

segments.src: But look what happens if their CRM data does the work instead.
segments.tr: Namun, lihatlah apa yang terjadi jika data CRM mereka yang melakukan pekerjaan tersebut.

segments.src: Digging into the customer records, they notice a pattern: most cancellations cluster right after month five, and those customers had never tried anything but the house blend.
segments.tr: Meneliti catatan pelanggan, mereka melihat sebuah pola: sebagian besar pembatalan berkumpul tepat setelah bulan kelima, dan para pelanggan tersebut tidak pernah mencoba apa pun selain campuran rumah (house blend).

segments.src: So they set up an automated CRM flow — at month four, anyone who's only ever ordered one product gets an email with a free single-origin sample in their next box.
segments.tr: Jadi, mereka menyiapkan alur CRM otomatis — pada bulan keempat, siapa pun yang baru pernah memesan satu produk mendapatkan email dengan sampel asal tunggal gratis di kotak berikutnya.

segments.src: Say that pushes average retention from 18 months to 24:
segments.tr: Katakanlah itu mendorong rata-rata retensi dari 18 bulan menjadi 24:

segments.src: Same ad budget.
segments.tr: Anggaran iklan yang sama.

segments.src: Same CAC.
segments.tr: CAC yang sama.

segments.src: A 33% jump in customer value, bought with an email and a sample bag.
segments.tr: Lonjakan 33% dalam nilai pelanggan, dibeli dengan satu email dan satu tas sampel.

segments.src: That's the whole argument for CRM in one example.
segments.tr: Itulah argumen keseluruhan untuk CRM dalam satu contoh.

segments.src: Performance marketing can usually shave CAC by maybe 10–20% before you hit the floor of what a click costs in a competitive auction.
segments.tr: Pemasaran performa biasanya dapat memangkas CAC sekitar 10–20% sebelum Anda mencapai batas bawah dari biaya klik dalam lelang yang kompetitif.

segments.src: Retention has far more headroom — and unlike your ad account, no competitor can bid it away from you.
segments.tr: Retensi memiliki ruang gerak yang jauh lebih besar — dan tidak seperti akun iklan Anda, tidak ada pesaing yang dapat menawarnya dari Anda.

segments.src: The flip side is real too: if Cedar & Co.
segments.tr: Sisi sebaliknya juga nyata: jika Cedar & Co.

segments.src: had lousy coffee, no CRM flow would save them.
segments.tr: memiliki kopi yang buruk, tidak ada alur CRM yang akan menyelamatkan mereka.

segments.src: Retention work amplifies a product people want.
segments.tr: Pekerjaan retensi memperkuat produk yang memang diinginkan orang.

segments.src: It does not manufacture one.
segments.tr: Pekerjaan ini tidak menciptakan produk tersebut.

segments.src: ## Three-Line Summary
segments.tr: ## Ringkasan Tiga Baris

segments.src: 1. **CLV** is the profit a customer generates over the whole relationship; compared against **CAC**, it tells you whether growth is actually creating value or just buying revenue.
segments.tr: 1. **CLV** adalah keuntungan yang dihasilkan pelanggan selama seluruh hubungan; jika dibandingkan dengan **CAC**, itu memberi tahu Anda apakah pertumbuhan benar-benar menciptakan nilai atau sekadar membeli pendapatan.

segments.src: 2. **Performance marketing** lowers the cost of acquiring customers; **CRM** raises what each one is worth — and retention usually has more room to move.
segments.tr: 2. **Performance marketing** menurunkan biaya perolehan pelanggan; **CRM** meningkatkan nilai setiap pelanggan — dan retensi biasanya memiliki lebih banyak ruang untuk bergerak.

segments.src: 3. Dashboards show correlation, not causation, so test your ad claims against a holdout before you trust them.
segments.tr: 3. Dasbor menunjukkan korelasi, bukan kausalitas, jadi ujilah klaim iklan Anda terhadap kelompok penahan (holdout) sebelum Anda mempercayainya.

segments.src: ## ✅ Self Quiz
segments.tr: ## ✅ Kuis Mandiri

segments.src: **1.** A company reports an LTV:CAC ratio of 1.2:1.
segments.tr: **1.** Sebuah perusahaan melaporkan rasio LTV:CAC sebesar 1,2:1.

segments.src: What does that most likely mean?
segments.tr: Apa arti yang paling mungkin dari hal tersebut?

segments.src: - (a) The business is healthy and should spend more on ads
segments.tr: - (a) Bisnis ini sehat dan harus menghabiskan lebih banyak untuk iklan

segments.src: - (b) It costs nearly as much to acquire a customer as that customer will ever return in profit
segments.tr: - (b) Biaya untuk mendapatkan pelanggan hampir sama besarnya dengan keuntungan yang akan dikembalikan oleh pelanggan tersebut

segments.src: - (c) The CRM system is misconfigured
segments.tr: - (c) Sistem CRM salah dikonfigurasi

segments.src: - (d) Gross margin is too high
segments.tr: - (d) Margin kotor terlalu tinggi

segments.src: **2.** (O/X) Improving customer retention can raise CLV without increasing ad spend at all.
segments.tr: **2.** (B/S) Meningkatkan retensi pelanggan dapat menaikkan CLV tanpa meningkatkan pengeluaran iklan sama sekali.

segments.src: **3.** Which of these is a CRM system best suited for?
segments.tr: **3.** Manakah dari berikut ini yang paling cocok untuk sistem CRM?

segments.src: - (a) Proving that a specific ad campaign *caused* a sale
segments.tr: - (a) Membuktikan bahwa kampanye iklan tertentu *menyebabkan* penjualan

segments.src: - (b) Setting the optimal price for a product
segments.tr: - (b) Menetapkan harga yang optimal untuk produk

segments.src: - (c) Keeping one shared record of each customer's history so teams can act on it
segments.tr: - (c) Menyimpan satu catatan bersama dari riwayat setiap pelanggan agar tim dapat menindaklanjutinya

segments.src: - (d) Replacing the need for a marketing strategy
segments.tr: - (d) Menggantikan kebutuhan akan strategi pemasaran

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 Istilah Hari Ini

segments.src: - **Customer Lifetime Value (CLV / LTV)** — the total profit a business expects from a single customer over the full length of the relationship.
segments.tr: - **Customer Lifetime Value (CLV / LTV)** — total keuntungan yang diharapkan bisnis dari satu pelanggan selama keseluruhan hubungan.

segments.src: - **Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC)** — total sales and marketing spend divided by the number of new customers it produced.
segments.tr: - **Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC)** — total pengeluaran penjualan dan pemasaran dibagi dengan jumlah pelanggan baru yang dihasilkannya.

segments.src: - **Churn Rate** — the share of customers who stop buying or cancel in a given period; the direct enemy of CLV.
segments.tr: - **Churn Rate** — persentase pelanggan yang berhenti membeli atau membatalkan dalam periode tertentu; musuh utama CLV.

segments.src: - **ROAS (Return on Ad Spend)** — revenue generated per dollar of advertising, the standard scorecard of performance marketing.
segments.tr: - **ROAS (Return on Ad Spend)** — pendapatan yang dihasilkan per dolar iklan, kartu skor standar pemasaran kinerja.

segments.src: - **CRM** — both the practice of managing customer relationships over time and the software that centralizes each customer's history so those relationships can be acted on at scale.
segments.tr: - **CRM** — baik praktik mengelola hubungan pelanggan dari waktu ke waktu maupun perangkat lunak yang memusatkan riwayat setiap pelanggan sehingga hubungan tersebut dapat ditindaklanjuti dalam skala besar.

segments.src: *Answers: 1 — (b).
segments.tr: *Jawaban: 1 — (b).

segments.src: At 1.2:1 there's almost no margin left to cover overhead, product development, or mistakes; growth like this consumes cash rather than generating it.
segments.tr: Pada 1,2:1 hampir tidak ada margin tersisa untuk menutupi overhead, pengembangan produk, atau kesalahan; pertumbuhan seperti ini mengonsumsi uang tunai alih-alih menghasilkannya.

segments.src: Retention is the "years retained" term in the CLV formula, and stretching it costs nothing in media spend.
segments.tr: Retensi adalah istilah "tahun yang dipertahankan" dalam formula CLV, dan memperpanjangnya tidak membutuhkan biaya dalam pengeluaran media.

segments.src: A CRM is a system of record that makes targeted action possible; proving causation requires an incrementality test with a holdout group, not a CRM.*
segments.tr: CRM adalah sistem pencatatan yang memungkinkan tindakan yang ditargetkan; membuktikan kausalitas memerlukan uji inkrementalisme dengan kelompok penahan, bukan CRM.*

ja.title: [Marketing 101 #13] あなたが獲得する最も安い顧客とは、すでにあなたの顧客である人だ

segments.src: > Modern marketing runs on two questions: what is a customer worth over their whole relationship with you, and how much did it cost to get them? Everything else — the CRM, the dashboards, the ad spend — exists to answer those two.
segments.tr: > Modern marketing runs on two questions: what is a customer worth over their whole relationship with you, and how much did it cost to get them? Everything else — the CRM, the dashboards, the ad spend — exists to answer those two.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## 本日のコンセプト

segments.src: For most of the 20th century, marketing was measured in *transactions*.
segments.tr: 20世紀の大半において、マーケティングは*トランザクション（取引）*単位で測定されていました。

segments.src: You ran a campaign, sales went up or they didn't, and you moved on.
segments.tr: キャンペーンを実施し、売上が伸びたかどうかを確認して、次に進むという形でした。

segments.src: Data-driven marketing swaps the unit of measurement from the transaction to the **relationship**.
segments.tr: データ駆動型のマーケティングでは、測定単位がトランザクションから**リレーションシップ（関係性）**に変わります。

segments.src: The core number is **customer lifetime value (CLV, sometimes LTV)** — the total profit you expect from one customer across the entire time they stay with you.
segments.tr: 中心となる数値は **顧客生涯価値（CLV、LTVとも呼ばれる）** です。これは、1人の顧客があなたとの関係を継続する全期間を通じて生み出すと期待される総利益を指します。

segments.src: For a repeat-purchase business, the plain-English version looks like this:
segments.tr: リピート購入型のビジネスの場合、分かりやすい言葉に置き換えると次のようになります：

segments.src: CLV = average order value  x  orders per year  x  gross margin  x  years retained
segments.tr: CLV = average order value  x  orders per year  x  gross margin  x  years retained

segments.src: Set that next to what it cost to win the customer — **customer acquisition cost (CAC)**, which is total sales and marketing spend divided by new customers acquired — and you get the ratio that quietly governs a lot of business decisions:
segments.tr: それを、顧客を獲得するためにかかったコスト（総営業・マーケティング費用を獲得した新規顧客数で割った**顧客獲得単価（CAC）**）と比較すると、多くのビジネス上の意思決定を静かに左右する比率が得られます：

segments.src: LTV : CAC
segments.tr: LTV : CAC

segments.src: The common rule of thumb in subscription and DTC businesses is that a healthy ratio is around 3:1.
segments.tr: サブスクリプションおよびDTC（Direct-to-Consumer）ビジネスにおける一般的な経験則では、健全な比率は約3:1です。

segments.src: That number is a heuristic, not a law of nature — a business with fat margins and cheap servicing can survive on less; one with heavy fulfillment costs needs more.
segments.tr: その数字は自然の法則ではなくヒューリスティック（発見法）であり、高い粗利益と低い維持コストを持つビジネスならそれ以下でも生き残れますが、重いフルフィルメント費用がかかるビジネスにはより高い比率が必要です。

segments.src: The useful part isn't the magic number.
segments.tr: 重要なのは魔法の数字そのものではありません。

segments.src: It's the realization that **you can improve the ratio from either side**: spend less to acquire, or keep people longer.
segments.tr: **比率はどちらの側からでも改善できる**、つまり獲得コストを下げるか、顧客に長く滞在してもらうかという点に気づくことです。

segments.src: Two disciplines sit on either side of that ratio.
segments.tr: その比率の両側には2つの領域が存在します。

segments.src: **Performance marketing** works the CAC side.
segments.tr: **パフォーマンスマーケティング**はCAC側を担当します。

segments.src: It's advertising bought and judged on measurable outcomes — clicks, signups, purchases — rather than on impressions or brand sentiment.
segments.tr: これは、インプレッションやブランドの感情ではなく、クリック、サインアップ、購入といった測定可能な成果に基づいて購入・評価される広告です。

segments.src: Its native metrics are CAC and **ROAS** (revenue divided by ad spend).
segments.tr: その固有の指標はCACと **ROAS**（売上を広告費で割ったもの）です。

segments.src: Its superpower is fast feedback; you can kill a bad ad in a day.
segments.tr: その最大の強みはフィードバックの速さであり、効果の低い広告は1日で停止できます。

segments.src: **CRM** — customer relationship management — works the retention side.
segments.tr: **CRM**（カスタマー・リレーションシップ・マネジメント）はリテンション（維持）側を担当します。

segments.src: The phrase means two things at once: the *practice* of managing customer relationships deliberately, and the *software* (Salesforce, HubSpot, Klaviyo, and dozens more) that stores every customer's purchases, emails, support tickets, and behavior in one record.
segments.tr: このフレーズは2つの意味を同時に持ちます。顧客関係を意図的に管理する*実践*と、すべての顧客の購入、メール、サポートチケット、行動を1つのレコードに保存する*ソフトウェア*（Salesforce、HubSpot、Klaviyoなど多数）です。

segments.src: The software matters because it turns "we should really follow up with lapsed buyers" into a query you can actually run and a message you can actually send.
segments.tr: ソフトウェアが重要な理由は、「休眠状態の購入者にそろそろフォローアップの連絡を入れるべきだ」という考えを、実際に実行できるクエリと送信できるメッセージに変えてくれるからです。

segments.src: One honest caveat before the example: these systems measure *correlation with* a sale, not *cause of* a sale.
segments.tr: 例に入る前の率直な注意点として、これらのシステムは売上の*原因*ではなく、売上との*相関関係*を測定しているということがあります。

segments.src: A returning customer who was going to buy anyway may click your retargeting ad on the way — and the ad gets the credit.
segments.tr: どうせ買うつもりだったリピーターが、その途中でリターゲティング広告をクリックするかもしれず、その場合広告に成果が帰属してしまいます。

segments.src: Privacy changes across browsers and mobile platforms over the past several years have also made click-level tracking less complete than the dashboards imply.
segments.tr: ここ数年のブラウザやモバイルプラットフォームにおけるプライバシーの変更により、クリックレベルのトラッキングはダッシュボードが示すほど完全ではなくなっています。

segments.src: Serious teams check their attribution numbers against **incrementality tests** — holding ads back from a randomized region or audience and comparing sales to a region that still sees them.
segments.tr: 真剣なチームは、広告をランダムな地域やオーディエンスに非表示にし、非表示にしなかった地域と比較する**インクリメンタリテスト（増分テスト）**とアトリビューション数値を照らし合わせます。

segments.src: It's the closest thing marketing has to a control group.
segments.tr: これはマーケティングにおいてコントロールグループ（対照群）に最も近いものです。

de.title: [Marketing 101 #13] Der günstigste Kunde, den Sie jemals gewinnen werden, ist der, den Sie bereits haben

segments.src: > Modern marketing runs on two questions: what is a customer worth over their whole relationship with you, and how much did it cost to get them? Everything else — the CRM, the dashboards, the ad spend — exists to answer those two.
segments.tr: > Modernes Marketing basiert auf zwei Fragen: Was ist ein Kunde während seiner gesamten Beziehung zu Ihnen wert und wie viel hat es gekostet, ihn zu gewinnen? Alles andere – das CRM, die Dashboards, die Werbeausgaben – existiert, um diese beiden Fragen zu beantworten.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## Das heutige Konzept

segments.src: For most of the 20th century, marketing was measured in *transactions*.
segments.tr: Während des größten Teils des 20. Jahrhunderts wurde Marketing in *Transaktionen* gemessen.

segments.src: You ran a campaign, sales went up or they didn't, and you moved on.
segments.tr: Sie haben eine Kampagne durchgeführt, der Umsatz stieg oder eben nicht, und Sie sind zum nächsten Schritt übergegangen.

segments.src: Data-driven marketing swaps the unit of measurement from the transaction to the **relationship**.
segments.tr: Datengestütztes Marketing tauscht die Maßeinheit von der Transaktion gegen die **Beziehung** aus.

segments.src: The core number is **customer lifetime value (CLV, sometimes LTV)** — the total profit you expect from one customer across the entire time they stay with you.
segments.tr: Die Kernzahl ist der **Customer Lifetime Value (CLV, manchmal LTV)** – der gesamte Gewinn, den Sie von einem Kunden über die gesamte Dauer seiner Bindung an Sie erwarten.

segments.src: For a repeat-purchase business, the plain-English version looks like this:
segments.tr: Für ein Unternehmen mit Wiederholungskäufen sieht die einfache Version auf Deutsch so aus:

segments.src: CLV = average order value  x  orders per year  x  gross margin  x  years retained
segments.tr: CLV = average order value  x  orders per year  x  gross margin  x  years retained

segments.src: Set that next to what it cost to win the customer — **customer acquisition cost (CAC)**, which is total sales and marketing spend divided by new customers acquired — and you get the ratio that quietly governs a lot of business decisions:
segments.tr: Stellen Sie das demgegenüber, was es gekostet hat, den Kunden zu gewinnen – die **Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC)**, was den Gesamtumsatz sowie die Marketingausgaben geteilt durch die gewonnenen Neukunden darstellt –, und Sie erhalten das Verhältnis, das viele geschäftliche Entscheidungen im Hintergrund bestimmt:

segments.src: LTV : CAC
segments.tr: LTV : CAC

segments.src: The common rule of thumb in subscription and DTC businesses is that a healthy ratio is around 3:1.
segments.tr: Die übliche Daumenregel in Abonnements- und Direktvertriebsunternehmen besagt, dass ein gesundes Verhältnis bei etwa 3:1 liegt.

segments.src: That number is a heuristic, not a law of nature — a business with fat margins and cheap servicing can survive on less; one with heavy fulfillment costs needs more.
segments.tr: Diese Zahl ist eine Heuristik, kein Naturgesetz – ein Unternehmen mit hohen Margen und geringem Betreuungsaufwand kann mit weniger überleben; eines mit hohen Erfüllungskosten benötigt mehr.

segments.src: The useful part isn't the magic number.
segments.tr: Das Nützliche ist nicht die magische Zahl.

segments.src: It's the realization that **you can improve the ratio from either side**: spend less to acquire, or keep people longer.
segments.tr: Es ist die Erkenntnis, dass **Sie das Verhältnis von beiden Seiten aus verbessern können**: weniger für die Akquise ausgeben oder die Leute länger halten.

segments.src: Two disciplines sit on either side of that ratio.
segments.tr: Zwei Disziplinen stehen auf beiden Seiten dieses Verhältnisses.

segments.src: **Performance marketing** works the CAC side.
segments.tr: **Performance-Marketing** bearbeitet die CAC-Seite.

segments.src: It's advertising bought and judged on measurable outcomes — clicks, signups, purchases — rather than on impressions or brand sentiment.
segments.tr: Es handelt sich um Werbung, die nach messbaren Ergebnissen – Klicks, Anmeldungen, Käufen – eingekauft und bewertet wird, und nicht nach Impressionen oder Markenstimmung.

segments.src: Its native metrics are CAC and **ROAS** (revenue divided by ad spend).
segments.tr: Seine ureigenen Kennzahlen sind CAC und **ROAS** (Umsatz geteilt durch Werbeausgaben).

segments.src: Its superpower is fast feedback; you can kill a bad ad in a day.
segments.tr: Seine Superkraft ist das schnelle Feedback; Sie können eine schlechte Anzeige innerhalb eines Tages stoppen.

segments.src: **CRM** — customer relationship management — works the retention side.
segments.tr: **CRM** – Customer Relationship Management – bearbeitet die Bindungsseite.

segments.src: The phrase means two things at once: the *practice* of managing customer relationships deliberately, and the *software* (Salesforce, HubSpot, Klaviyo, and dozens more) that stores every customer's purchases, emails, support tickets, and behavior in one record.
segments.tr: Der Begriff bedeutet zwei Dinge gleichzeitig: die *Praxis*, Kundenbeziehungen bewusst zu verwalten, und die *Software* (Salesforce, HubSpot, Klaviyo und viele andere), die die Käufe, E-Mails, Support-Tickets und das Verhalten jedes Kunden in einem einzigen Datensatz speichert.

segments.src: The software matters because it turns "we should really follow up with lapsed buyers" into a query you can actually run and a message you can actually send.
segments.tr: Die Software ist wichtig, weil sie aus „wir sollten uns wirklich mal bei abgewanderten Käufern melden“ eine Abfrage macht, die Sie tatsächlich ausführen können, und eine Nachricht, die Sie tatsächlich senden können.

segments.src: One honest caveat before the example: these systems measure *correlation with* a sale, not *cause of* a sale.
segments.tr: Ein ehrlicher Vorbehalt vor dem Beispiel: Diese Systeme messen die *Korrelation mit* einem Verkauf, nicht die *Ursache für* einen Verkauf.

segments.src: A returning customer who was going to buy anyway may click your retargeting ad on the way — and the ad gets the credit.
segments.tr: Ein wiederkehrender Kunde, der sowieso kaufen wollte, klickt möglicherweise auf dem Weg dorthin auf Ihre Retargeting-Anzeige – und die Anzeige erhält die Gutschrift.

segments.src: Privacy changes across browsers and mobile platforms over the past several years have also made click-level tracking less complete than the dashboards imply.
segments.tr: Datenschutzänderungen in Browsern und mobilen Plattformen in den letzten Jahren haben zudem dafür gesorgt, dass das Tracking auf Klick-Ebene unvollständiger ist, als die Dashboards vermuten lassen.

segments.src: Serious teams check their attribution numbers against **incrementality tests** — holding ads back from a randomized region or audience and comparing sales to a region that still sees them.
segments.tr: Seriöse Teams überprüfen ihre Attributionszahlen anhand von **Inkrementalitätstests** – indem sie Anzeigen von einer randomisierten Region oder Zielgruppe zurückhalten und die Verkäufe mit einer Region vergleichen, in der sie immer noch geschaltet werden.

segments.src: It's the closest thing marketing has to a control group.
segments.tr: Das ist das Äquivalent, das das Marketing einer Kontrollgruppe am nächsten hat.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## Im Alltag

segments.src: Take Cedar & Co., a small coffee roaster in Denver selling 12 oz bags online at $18, with a 40% gross margin.
segments.tr: Nehmen wir Cedar & Co., eine kleine Kaffeerösterei in Denver, die 12-Unzen-Beutel online für 18 $ bei einer Bruttomarge von 40 % verkauft.

segments.src: They run Meta and Google ads and pay about **$45 to acquire each new customer**.
segments.tr: Sie schalten Meta- und Google-Anzeigen und zahlen etwa **45 $ für die Akquise jedes Neukunden**.

segments.src: Their typical subscriber orders once a month and sticks around 18 months.
segments.tr: Ihr typischer Abonnent bestellt einmal im Monat und bleibt etwa 18 Monate.

segments.src: CLV = $18 x 12 orders/yr x 0.40 margin x 1.5 years = $129.60
segments.tr: CLV = $18 x 12 orders/yr x 0.40 margin x 1.5 years = $129.60

segments.src: Workable, not comfortable.
segments.tr: Machbar, aber nicht komfortabel.

segments.src: The founder's instinct is to fix it by finding cheaper ads.
segments.tr: Der Instinkt des Gründers besteht darin, das Problem durch die Suche nach günstigeren Anzeigen zu lösen.

segments.src: But look what happens if their CRM data does the work instead.
segments.tr: Aber schauen Sie, was passiert, wenn stattdessen ihre CRM-Daten die Arbeit machen.

segments.src: Digging into the customer records, they notice a pattern: most cancellations cluster right after month five, and those customers had never tried anything but the house blend.
segments.tr: Bei der Durchsuchung der Kundendatensätze fällt ihnen ein Muster auf: Die meisten Kündigungen häufen sich direkt nach dem fünften Monat, und diese Kunden hatten nie etwas anderes als die Hausmischung probiert.

segments.src: So they set up an automated CRM flow — at month four, anyone who's only ever ordered one product gets an email with a free single-origin sample in their next box.
segments.tr: Also richten sie einen automatisierten CRM-Ablauf ein – im vierten Monat erhält jeder, der jemals nur ein einziges Produkt bestellt hat, eine E-Mail mit einer kostenlosen Probe einer sortenreinen Kaffeesorte in seiner nächsten Box.

segments.src: Say that pushes average retention from 18 months to 24:
segments.tr: Nehmen wir an, das steigert die durchschnittliche Bindung von 18 Monaten auf 24:

segments.src: Same ad budget.
segments.tr: Gleiches Werbebudget.

segments.src: Same CAC.
segments.tr: Gleicher CAC.

segments.src: A 33% jump in customer value, bought with an email and a sample bag.
segments.tr: Ein Sprung des Kundenwerts um 33 %, erkauft mit einer E-Mail und einer Probepackung.

segments.src: That's the whole argument for CRM in one example.
segments.tr: Das ist das ganze Argument für CRM in einem einzigen Beispiel.

segments.src: Performance marketing can usually shave CAC by maybe 10–20% before you hit the floor of what a click costs in a competitive auction.
segments.tr: Performance-Marketing kann den CAC normalerweise um vielleicht 10–20 % senken, bevor man an die Untergrenze dessen stößt, was ein Klick in einer wettbewerbsorientierten Auktion kostet.

segments.src: Retention has far more headroom — and unlike your ad account, no competitor can bid it away from you.
segments.tr: Die Kundenbindung hat weitaus mehr Spielraum – und im Gegensatz zu Ihrem Werbekonto kann kein Konkurrent diesen von Ihnen weg bieten.

segments.src: The flip side is real too: if Cedar & Co.
segments.tr: Die Kehrseite ist ebenfalls real: Wenn Cedar & Co.

segments.src: had lousy coffee, no CRM flow would save them.
segments.tr: schlechten Kaffee hätte, würde kein CRM-Ablauf sie retten.

segments.src: Retention work amplifies a product people want.
segments.tr: Die Arbeit an der Kundenbindung verstärkt ein Produkt, das die Leute wollen.

segments.src: It does not manufacture one.
segments.tr: Sie stellt keines her.

segments.tr: Con số cốt lõi là **giá trị vòng đời khách hàng (CLV, đôi khi là LTV)** — tổng lợi nhuận bạn mong đợi từ một khách hàng trong suốt thời gian họ gắn bó với bạn.

segments.src: For a repeat-purchase business, the plain-English version looks like this:
segments.tr: Đối với một doanh nghiệp mua lại nhiều lần, phiên bản tiếng Anh đơn giản trông như thế này:

segments.src: CLV = average order value  x  orders per year  x  gross margin  x  years retained
segments.tr: CLV = average order value  x  orders per year  x  gross margin  x  years retained

segments.src: Set that next to what it cost to win the customer — **customer acquisition cost (CAC)**, which is total sales and marketing spend divided by new customers acquired — and you get the ratio that quietly governs a lot of business decisions:
segments.tr: Đặt điều đó bên cạnh chi phí để giành được khách hàng — **chi phí có được khách hàng (CAC)**, là tổng chi phí bán hàng và marketing chia cho số khách hàng mới có được — và bạn sẽ có được tỷ lệ ngầm chi phối rất nhiều quyết định kinh doanh:

segments.src: LTV : CAC
segments.tr: LTV : CAC

segments.src: The common rule of thumb in subscription and DTC businesses is that a healthy ratio is around 3:1.
segments.tr: Quy tắc chung phổ biến trong các doanh nghiệp thuê bao và DTC là tỷ lệ lành mạnh khoảng 3:1.

segments.src: That number is a heuristic, not a law of nature — a business with fat margins and cheap servicing can survive on less; one with heavy fulfillment costs needs more.
segments.tr: Con số đó là một kinh nghiệm phỏng đoán, không phải quy luật tự nhiên — một doanh nghiệp có biên lợi nhuận béo bở và chi phí dịch vụ rẻ có thể tồn tại với mức thấp hơn; một doanh nghiệp có chi phí hoàn thành đơn hàng nặng nề cần nhiều hơn.

segments.src: The useful part isn't the magic number.
segments.tr: Phần hữu ích không phải là con số kỳ diệu.

segments.src: It's the realization that **you can improve the ratio from either side**: spend less to acquire, or keep people longer.
segments.tr: Đó là nhận thức rằng **bạn có thể cải thiện tỷ lệ từ cả hai phía**: chi tiêu ít hơn để có được, hoặc giữ chân mọi người lâu hơn.

segments.src: Two disciplines sit on either side of that ratio.
segments.tr: Hai lĩnh vực nằm ở hai bên của tỷ lệ đó.

segments.src: **Performance marketing** works the CAC side.
segments.tr: **Marketing hiệu suất** giải quyết phía CAC.

segments.src: It's advertising bought and judged on measurable outcomes — clicks, signups, purchases — rather than on impressions or brand sentiment.
segments.tr: Đó là quảng cáo được mua và đánh giá dựa trên các kết quả đo lường được — nhấp chuột, đăng ký, mua hàng — thay vì số lần hiển thị hoặc cảm sentiment về thương hiệu.

segments.src: Its native metrics are CAC and **ROAS** (revenue divided by ad spend).
segments.tr: Các số liệu gốc của nó là CAC và **ROAS** (doanh thu chia cho chi phí quảng cáo).

segments.src: Its superpower is fast feedback; you can kill a bad ad in a day.
segments.tr: Sức mạnh siêu phàm của nó là phản hồi nhanh chóng; bạn có thể dừng một quảng cáo tồi trong một ngày.

segments.src: **CRM** — customer relationship management — works the retention side.
segments.tr: **CRM** — quản lý quan hệ khách hàng — giải quyết phía giữ chân.

segments.src: The phrase means two things at once: the *practice* of managing customer relationships deliberately, and the *software* (Salesforce, HubSpot, Klaviyo, and dozens more) that stores every customer's purchases, emails, support tickets, and behavior in one record.
segments.tr: Cụm từ này có nghĩa là hai điều cùng một lúc: *thực tiễn* quản lý quan hệ khách hàng một cách có chủ đích, và *phần mềm* (Salesforce, HubSpot, Klaviyo và hàng tá phần mềm khác) lưu trữ các giao dịch mua hàng, email, phiếu hỗ trợ và hành vi của mọi khách hàng trong một hồ sơ duy nhất.

segments.src: The software matters because it turns "we should really follow up with lapsed buyers" into a query you can actually run and a message you can actually send.
segments.tr: Phần mềm quan trọng vì nó biến "chúng ta thực sự nên theo dõi những người mua đã lâu không quay lại" thành một truy vấn bạn thực sự có thể chạy và một tin nhắn bạn thực sự có thể gửi.

segments.src: One honest caveat before the example: these systems measure *correlation with* a sale, not *cause of* a sale.
segments.tr: Một lời cảnh báo thành thật trước ví dụ: các hệ thống này đo lường *sự tương quan với* một đợt bán hàng, chứ không phải *nguyên nhân gây ra* một đợt bán hàng.

segments.src: A returning customer who was going to buy anyway may click your retargeting ad on the way — and the ad gets the credit.
segments.tr: Một khách hàng quay lại, người mà dù sao cũng định mua hàng, có thể nhấp vào quảng cáo nhắm mục tiêu lại của bạn trên đường đi — và quảng cáo đó nhận được công trạng.

segments.src: Privacy changes across browsers and mobile platforms over the past several years have also made click-level tracking less complete than the dashboards imply.
segments.tr: Các thay đổi về quyền riêng tư trên các trình duyệt và nền tảng di động trong vài năm qua cũng làm cho việc theo dõi cấp độ nhấp chuột kém hoàn thiện hơn so với các bảng điều khiển ngụ ý.

segments.src: Serious teams check their attribution numbers against **incrementality tests** — holding ads back from a randomized region or audience and comparing sales to a region that still sees them.
segments.tr: Các đội ngũ nghiêm túc kiểm tra các con số quy cho của họ dựa trên **các thử nghiệm gia tăng** — giữ lại quảng cáo không cho hiển thị ở một khu vực hoặc đối tượng được chọn ngẫu nhiên và so sánh doanh số với một khu vực vẫn nhìn thấy chúng.

segments.src: It's the closest thing marketing has to a control group.
segments.tr: Đó là điều gần gũi nhất mà marketing có được với một nhóm đối chứng.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## Trong cuộc sống hàng ngày

segments.src: Take Cedar & Co., a small coffee roaster in Denver selling 12 oz bags online at $18, with a 40% gross margin.
segments.tr: Hãy lấy Cedar & Co., một cơ sở rang cà phê nhỏ ở Denver bán các túi 12 oz trực tuyến với giá $18, với biên lợi nhuận gộp 40%.

segments.src: They run Meta and Google ads and pay about **$45 to acquire each new customer**.
segments.tr: Họ chạy quảng cáo Meta và Google và trả khoảng **$45 để có được mỗi khách hàng mới**.

segments.src: Their typical subscriber orders once a month and sticks around 18 months.
segments.tr: Thuê bao điển hình của họ đặt hàng mỗi tháng một lần và gắn bó khoảng 18 tháng.

segments.src: CLV = $18 x 12 orders/yr x 0.40 margin x 1.5 years = $129.60
segments.tr: CLV = $18 x 12 orders/yr x 0.40 margin x 1.5 years = $129.60

segments.src: Workable, not comfortable.
segments.tr: Khả thi, nhưng không thoải mái.

segments.src: The founder's instinct is to fix it by finding cheaper ads.
segments.tr: Bản năng của nhà sáng lập là khắc phục nó bằng cách tìm kiếm quảng cáo rẻ hơn.

segments.src: But look what happens if their CRM data does the work instead.
segments.tr: Nhưng hãy nhìn điều gì xảy ra nếu dữ liệu CRM của họ làm thay công việc đó.

segments.src: Digging into the customer records, they notice a pattern: most cancellations cluster right after month five, and those customers had never tried anything but the house blend.
segments.tr: Đào sâu vào hồ sơ khách hàng, họ nhận thấy một điểm chung: phần lớn việc hủy bỏ tập trung ngay sau tháng thứ năm, và những khách hàng đó chưa bao giờ thử bất cứ thứ gì ngoài hỗn hợp nhà làm (house blend).

segments.src: So they set up an automated CRM flow — at month four, anyone who's only ever ordered one product gets an email with a free single-origin sample in their next box.
segments.tr: Vì vậy, họ thiết lập một quy trình CRM tự động — vào tháng thứ tư, bất kỳ ai chỉ từng đặt mua một sản phẩm sẽ nhận được một email kèm theo mẫu thử đơn nguồn (single-origin) miễn phí trong hộp tiếp theo của họ.

segments.src: Say that pushes average retention from 18 months to 24:
segments.tr: Giả sử điều đó đẩy tỷ lệ giữ chân trung bình từ 18 tháng lên 24:

segments.src: Same ad budget.
segments.tr: Cùng ngân sách quảng cáo.

segments.src: Same CAC.
segments.tr: Cùng CAC.

segments.src: A 33% jump in customer value, bought with an email and a sample bag.
segments.tr: Sự nhảy vọt 33% về giá trị khách hàng, được mua bằng một email và một túi mẫu thử.

segments.src: That's the whole argument for CRM in one example.
segments.tr: Đó là toàn bộ lập luận cho CRM trong một ví dụ.

segments.src: Performance marketing can usually shave CAC by maybe 10–20% before you hit the floor of what a click costs in a competitive auction.
segments.tr: Marketing hiệu suất thường có thể cắt giảm CAC khoảng 10–20% trước khi bạn chạm đáy chi phí cho một lần nhấp chuột trong một phiên đấu giá cạnh tranh.

segments.src: Retention has far more headroom — and unlike your ad account, no competitor can bid it away from you.
segments.tr: Việc giữ chân có nhiều không gian hơn rất nhiều — và không giống như tài khoản quảng cáo của bạn, không đối thủ cạnh tranh nào có thể đấu giá để cướp nó đi từ bạn.

segments.src: The flip side is real too: if Cedar & Co.
segments.tr: Mặt trái cũng có thật: nếu Cedar & Co.

segments.src: had lousy coffee, no CRM flow would save them.
segments.tr: có cà phê tồi tệ, không quy trình CRM nào có thể cứu họ.

segments.src: Retention work amplifies a product people want.
segments.tr: Công việc giữ chân khuếch đại một sản phẩm mà mọi người muốn.

segments.src: It does not manufacture one.
segments.tr: Nó không tạo ra sản phẩm đó.

segments.src: ## Three-Line Summary
segments.tr: ## Tóm tắt ba dòng

segments.src: 1. **CLV** is the profit a customer generates over the whole relationship; compared against **CAC**, it tells you whether growth is actually creating value or just buying revenue.
segments.tr: 1. **CLV** là lợi nhuận mà khách hàng tạo ra trong toàn bộ mối quan hệ; khi so sánh với **CAC**, nó cho bạn biết liệu sự tăng trưởng có thực sự tạo ra giá trị hay chỉ đơn thuần là mua doanh thu.

segments.src: 2. **Performance marketing** lowers the cost of acquiring customers; **CRM** raises what each one is worth — and retention usually has more room to move.
segments.tr: 2. **Marketing hiệu suất** làm giảm chi phí có được khách hàng; **CRM** nâng cao giá trị của mỗi khách hàng — và việc giữ chân thường có nhiều dư địa để di chuyển hơn.

segments.src: 3. Dashboards show correlation, not causation, so test your ad claims against a holdout before you trust them.
segments.tr: 3. Các bảng điều khiển hiển thị sự tương quan, không phải nguyên nhân, vì vậy hãy kiểm tra các tuyên bố quảng cáo của bạn dựa trên một nhóm giữ lại trước khi bạn tin tưởng chúng.

segments.src: ## ✅ Self Quiz
segments.tr: ## ✅ Trắc nghiệm tự kiểm tra

segments.src: **1.** A company reports an LTV:CAC ratio of 1.2:1.
segments.tr: **1.** Một công ty báo cáo tỷ lệ LTV:CAC là 1.2:1.

segments.src: What does that most likely mean?
segments.tr: Điều đó rất có khả năng có ý nghĩa gì?

segments.src: - (a) The business is healthy and should spend more on ads
segments.tr: - (a) Doanh nghiệp lành mạnh và nên chi nhiều hơn cho quảng cáo

segments.src: - (b) It costs nearly as much to acquire a customer as that customer will ever return in profit
segments.tr: - (b) Chi phí có được một khách hàng gần bằng với lợi nhuận mà khách hàng đó sẽ mang lại

segments.src: - (c) The CRM system is misconfigured
segments.tr: - (c) Hệ thống CRM bị cấu hình sai

segments.src: - (d) Gross margin is too high
segments.tr: - (d) Biên lợi nhuận gộp quá cao

segments.src: **2.** (O/X) Improving customer retention can raise CLV without increasing ad spend at all.
segments.tr: **2.** (O/X) Việc cải thiện tỷ lệ giữ chân khách hàng có thể nâng cao CLV mà không làm tăng chi phí quảng cáo chút nào.

segments.src: **3.** Which of these is a CRM system best suited for?
segments.tr: **3.** Hệ thống CRM thích hợp nhất cho điều nào sau đây?

segments.src: - (a) Proving that a specific ad campaign *caused* a sale
segments.tr: - (a) Chứng minh rằng một chiến dịch quảng cáo cụ thể *đã gây ra* một đợt bán hàng

segments.src: - (b) Setting the optimal price for a product
segments.tr: - (b) Thiết lập mức giá tối ưu cho một sản phẩm

segments.src: - (c) Keeping one shared record of each customer's history so teams can act on it
segments.tr: - (c) Giữ một hồ sơ chung về lịch sử của từng khách hàng để các đội ngũ có thể hành động dựa trên đó

segments.src: - (d) Replacing the need for a marketing strategy
segments.tr: - (d) Thay thế nhu cầu về một chiến lược marketing

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 Thuật ngữ hôm nay

segments.src: - **Customer Lifetime Value (CLV / LTV)** — the total profit a business expects from a single customer over the full length of the relationship.
segments.tr: - **Giá trị vòng đời khách hàng (CLV / LTV)** — tổng lợi nhuận mà một doanh nghiệp mong đợi từ một khách hàng duy nhất trong toàn bộ thời gian của mối quan hệ.

segments.src: - **Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC)** — total sales and marketing spend divided by the number of new customers it produced.
segments.tr: - **Chi phí có được khách hàng (CAC)** — tổng chi phí bán hàng và marketing chia cho số lượng khách hàng mới mà nó tạo ra.

segments.src: - **Churn Rate** — the share of customers who stop buying or cancel in a given period; the direct enemy of CLV.
segments.tr: - **Tỷ lệ rời bỏ (Churn Rate)** — tỷ lệ khách hàng ngừng mua hoặc hủy bỏ trong một khoảng thời gian nhất định; kẻ thù trực tiếp của CLV.

segments.src: - **ROAS (Return on Ad Spend)** — revenue generated per dollar of advertising, the standard scorecard of performance marketing.
segments.tr: - **ROAS (Lợi nhuận trên chi phí quảng cáo)** — doanh thu tạo ra trên mỗi đô la quảng cáo, bảng điểm tiêu chuẩn của marketing hiệu suất.

segments.src: - **CRM** — both the practice of managing customer relationships over time and the software that centralizes each customer's history so those relationships can be acted on at scale.
segments.tr: - **CRM** — vừa là thực tiễn quản lý quan hệ khách hàng theo thời gian vừa là phần mềm tập trung hóa lịch sử của từng khách hàng để những mối quan hệ đó có thể được hành động ở quy mô lớn.

segments.src: *Answers: 1 — (b).
segments.tr: *Đáp án: 1 — (b).

segments.src: At 1.2:1 there's almost no margin left to cover overhead, product development, or mistakes; growth like this consumes cash rather than generating it.
segments.tr: Ở mức 1.2:1 hầu như không còn biên độ nào để trang trải chi phí chung, phát triển sản phẩm hoặc sai sót; sự tăng trưởng như thế này ngốn tiền mặt thay vì tạo ra nó.

segments.src: Retention is the "years retained" term in the CLV formula, and stretching it costs nothing in media spend.
segments.tr: Giữ chân là thuật ngữ "số năm giữ lại" trong công thức CLV, và việc kéo dài nó không tốn kém gì trong chi phí truyền thông.

segments.src: A CRM is a system of record that makes targeted action possible; proving causation requires an incrementality test with a holdout group, not a CRM.*
segments.tr: CRM là một hệ thống ghi chép làm cho hành động có mục tiêu trở nên khả thi; việc chứng minh nguyên nhân đòi hỏi một thử nghiệm gia tăng với một nhóm giữ lại, chứ không phải một CRM.*
